hands-peekaboo:
A small plush bear cub in soft ochre sits upright, both felt paws just flung wide from its eyes, caught at the very moment of the reveal.
Three tiny stitched dots in a row on the rug beside it mark the slow count it waited out.
The mood is the delighted burst of boo!
cloth-on-your-face:
A plush lavender elephant lies on its back with a small cream knitted scarf draped over its head, only the curl of its trunk showing.
One corner of the scarf is lifted, just tugged by a tiny yellow felt chick sitting beside it.
The mood is giggly suspense: where did you go?
under-the-cup:
A soft terracotta clay cup sits upside down, tipped up at one edge, and a small yellow felt duck peeks out from under the rim with one bright dot eye.
A tiny pencil-drawn arc above the cup shows it has just been lifted.
The mood is the gasp of discovery: there it is!
sock-puppet-chat:
A sage green wool sock has become a puppet, with two button eyes and a terracotta felt tongue, popping up over the curve of a rolled cream blanket.
Facing it, a small knitted bunny sits with its head tilted, a single pencil-drawn sound curl floating from it.
The mood is a warm, back-and-forth chat.
toy-comet:
A small felt star with a soft ochre glow and a short trailing yarn tail hangs above the rug, paused mid-drift.
A faint dotted arc shows the slow path it just travelled from one side.
Below it, a tiny knitted lamb lies on its back, eyes turned up to catch the star.
The mood is slow, dreamy focus.
cushion-tunnel-toy:
A plump terracotta cushion stands on its edge in the middle of the rug like a little wall.
A wooden duck on wheels is halfway out from behind its far side, just its beak and front showing.
A faint dotted line runs behind the cushion, tracing the duck's hidden path.
The mood is curious anticipation: here it comes!
follow-their-gaze:
A small clay owl sits with its head tipped far back, gazing up at a little felt lamp with an ochre shade and a soft warm glow.
A faint dotted line runs from the owl's eyes to the lamp, and a paper moth rests nearby, the next thing to look at.
The mood is quiet, shared wonder.
babble-back:
Two felt songbirds face each other on a twig of knotted yarn: a bigger one in sage and a tiny round fledgling in cream.
Between them float pencil-drawn sound curls; the little bird's curl has just finished, and the big bird waits with its beak closed.
The mood is a gentle, turn-taking conversation.
missing-last-word:
A row of soft felt music notes in ochre and lavender drifts across the rug, then stops at an empty gap where the last note belongs.
That final note hovers just above the gap, about to land.
A small knitted frog sits beneath it, one leg mid-kick, looking up.
The mood is held breath, then joy.
lullaby-stop-start:
A sleepy plush koala lies on its back with a tiny felt koala curled on top of it, both perfectly still.
A trail of small felt music notes has stopped mid-air above them, the last note frozen.
The little koala has just lifted its head, eyes open, asking for more.
The mood is soft, sleepy hush.
copy-cat-faces:
Two knitted cats sit face to face, a big sage cat and a little cream kitten, both poking out the same tiny terracotta felt tongue.
Now the big cat's stitched brows are raised in a new, slow, surprised look, and the kitten is just starting to copy it.
The mood is playful mimicry.
little-piggy-pause:
Five little felt piglets in graded sizes stand in a row, from a big one to a tiny one, in soft terracotta and cream.
The smallest piglet at the end is frozen mid-step, one trotter lifted, about to dash off.
A faint dotted trail curls away ahead of it, the path it is about to run along.
The mood is giggling suspense before the run.
round-the-garden:
A little clay snail has just circled a flat felt flower in the middle of the rug, its dotted trail spiralling round the petals.
The trail then climbs straight toward a sleepy plush hedgehog, and the snail has frozen just short of the hedgehog's nose.
The mood is giggly, tickly suspense.
floor-mirror-faces:
A small round mirror in a carved wooden frame is propped on the rug, its glass holding the soft reflection of a felt penguin.
The real penguin lies on its front beside it, caught mid-turn between its reflection and the open rug.
The mood is curious, gentle wonder.
ready-steady-raspberry:
A plush round otter lies on its back, flippers up, kicking with delight.
Just above it, a soft felt cloud bursts with wobbly pencil-drawn ripple lines, as if a raspberry has just landed.
Three stitched dots beside it, the last one larger, mark ready, steady, go.
The mood is giggly, bubbly delight.
baby-mind-reader:
A small felt mouse sits stretching toward a little wooden spoon lying just out of its reach.
Above it float two soft felt thought bubbles: one holding a tiny spoon, the other a small jagged pencil burst for a sudden noise.
The mood is warm, calm understanding.
lamp-off-lamp-on:
A small handmade bedside lamp with a pleated cream fabric shade and a round clay base, its bulb glowing a soft warm gold, a little pull cord with a wooden bead hanging from it.
The glow pools on the rug around the lamp, and the rug's far edge falls into a soft dusky lavender shade, as if the light has only just come back on.
The mood is a hushed, cozy surprise.
wheres-your-nose:
A round clay hippo in soft lavender sits upright, and a little felt butterfly has just landed on the tip of its nose.
Tiny felt stars hover by its ear and its tail, like little markers waiting to be found next.
The mood is gentle, cheerful discovery.
flat-out-story:
A small cloth picture book stands open like a tent above the rug, its pages painted with a simple sun, a fish and a flower.
Below it, a knitted bunny and a tiny felt fox lie side by side on their backs, both looking up at the same flower.
The mood is calm, cosy storytime.
slow-fist-open:
A large cream felt flower bud sits on the rug with its petals opening one at a time; two petals are open and the rest still curled shut.
Poking out from inside is the tip of a tiny ochre wooden rattle.
A little felt squirrel sits beside it, nose close, watching.
The mood is slow-burn curiosity: what's in there?
sock-foot-vanish:
A small lavender knitted blanket lies in a soft heap with a wiggling bump underneath, and the tip of a striped sage sock pokes out from one edge.
Faint pencil wiggle lines dance around the bump.
A felt raccoon crouches beside it, one paw on the blanket's corner, ready to pull.
The mood is giggly discovery.
something-moves:
A tiny paper pinwheel on a wooden stick turns slowly in the middle of the rug, its petals blurred mid-spin, a soft shadow circling beneath it.
A small plush seal lies on its back nearby, gazing up at it, perfectly still.
The mood is quiet, hypnotic calm.
tummy-time-name:
Two felt badgers lie on their fronts facing each other a short way apart: a large grey-sage one and a tiny cream cub.
The cub has just turned its head back to meet the big badger's warm stitched smile, a faint dotted line linking their eyes.
The mood is tender recognition.
toy-give-back:
A small wooden rattle ring sits halfway between two toys: a tall knitted giraffe bending its neck low, and a tiny felt fawn nudging the ring toward it.
A faint dotted arc shows the ring sliding over, and another arc curves back, ready for the return.
The mood is patient, kind turn-taking.
eyes-on-me:
A clay owl with big round eyes sits facing forward, its gaze steady and warm, a few pencil-drawn humming curls drifting from it.
At the very edge of the rug, a small jingly felt bell peeks out for a moment from under a fold, trying to steal the look.
The mood is warm, steady attention.
look-where-i-look:
Two toys sit side by side at the front of the rug: a small wooden car in sage and a felt ball in ochre.
Behind them a plush bear and a tiny bear cub both turn their heads toward the ball, the cub a beat behind, faint dotted lines linking their eyes to it.
The mood is quiet, shared focus.
uh-oh-cup:
A plush grey-lavender walrus lies on its back, and a small terracotta clay cup has just slid off its round head, caught mid-tumble in the air.
A faint pencil arc traces the cup's fall toward the rug.
The mood is giggly uh-oh suspense.
snore-and-wake:
A big plush lion lies on its back, eyes stitched shut, soft felt snore puffs rising above it.
A tiny felt mouse has just tapped its woolly mane, and one of the lion's eyes has popped open in slow surprise.
The mood is playful and sleepy-silly.
pick-one-toy:
Two toys hover a little apart above the rug, as if just offered: a small wooden boat and a soft felt star.
Below them, a small knitted koala leans toward the star, one paw reaching, eyes fixed on it.
The mood is a calm, careful choice.
house-sounds:
Around the rug's edge sit three handmade sound-makers: a clay kettle with a curl of felt steam, a little brass-coloured felt bell, and a knitted toy dog, each with a faint pencil sound ripple.
In the middle, a small felt deer sits with its head turned toward the kettle, ears up.
The mood is calm, attentive listening.
scarf-tug-turns:
A long sage and cream striped knitted scarf stretches across the rug in a gentle curve.
One end is held in the beak of a wooden duck, the other in the paws of a small felt fox, the middle just going slack after a tug.
The mood is gentle, give-and-take play.
peeking-tail:
A soft lavender felt cloth lies over a small toy, and only the bushy ochre yarn tail of a felt squirrel peeks out from one side.
One corner of the cloth is just lifted, a faint pencil arc above it.
The mood is the little thrill of finding.
two-hands-full:
A small plush monkey sits holding a wooden block in one paw and a felt ball in the other, both paws full.
A third toy, a little clay rattle, rests just in front of it, inviting.
The monkey's head tilts as it puzzles over what to do.
The mood is curious, thoughtful problem-solving.
empty-cup-tea:
A small clay teapot and two empty cream cups sit on the rug.
A plush hedgehog lifts one cup for a pretend sip, faint pencil slurp curls rising from it, while a tiny felt mouse holds the other cup high for a cheers.
The mood is silly, cosy pretend.
row-boat-stop:
A small wooden rowing boat in sage and ochre sits on waves of blue-grey felt, tipped far back mid-rock.
Inside, a plush otter holds two little oars, frozen mid-stroke, and a row of felt music notes has stopped in the air above.
The mood is a cheeky pause before rocking on.
patacake-pause:
A small clay baking tray with a round felt cake sits between two toys facing each other: a felt fox and a knitted lamb.
Their paws are held wide open, frozen just before the big clap, faint pencil marks showing the beat of earlier pats.
The mood is bright, held-breath anticipation.
trot-to-boston:
A little wooden rocking horse in ochre with a yarn mane tips forward at the low point of its dip.
A tiny yellow felt chick rides on top, holding on, eyes wide.
Faint pencil motion arcs behind it show the bouncing trot that came before.
The mood is bouncy, giggly anticipation.
two-cup-switch:
Two terracotta clay cups sit upside down side by side.
One is tipped up at the edge, showing a little knitted frog tucked underneath, and a faint dotted arc shows the frog has just hopped across from the other cup.
The mood is a playful little trick with a happy find.
drop-and-tip:
A tall cream clay cup lies tipped on its side, and a small sage wooden block is tumbling out of its mouth onto the rug.
A rolled lavender sock waits beside it for the next drop, and faint pencil rattle lines hover by the cup from the shake.
The mood is surprised delight: there it is!
knock-on-three:
A tower of four stacked clay cups in sage, ochre, cream and lavender leans mid-topple, the top cup just leaving the stack.
A small felt penguin stands beside it, flipper still raised from the swipe.
Three stitched dots on the rug mark the count.
The mood is gleeful crash time.
ball-back:
A soft knitted ball in ochre and cream stripes rolls across the rug between a plush lavender elephant and a small clay turtle.
A dotted trail behind the ball shows the turtle has just nudged it back, and the elephant's trunk is curled, ready to catch.
The mood is patient, happy back-and-forth.
thank-you-swap:
A small felt raccoon offers a tiny wooden rattle to a knitted lamb, the rattle hanging right between them as both hold on for one beat.
A second toy, a soft felt star, waits on the rug nearby for the next swap.
The mood is gentle, polite sharing.
sock-drop-look:
A rolled cream wool sock hangs in mid-air above the rug, falling, a faint pencil line tracing its drop.
Below it, a small clay turtle stretches its neck to peer down at the spot where it will land.
The mood is curious, wide-eyed watching.
book-where-dog:
A cloth picture book lies open on the rug, its pages painted with simple pictures: a little dog, a ball and a tree.
A tiny knitted puppy toy sits beside the book, nose almost touching the painted dog on the page.
The mood is curious, cosy pointing and naming.
switch-boss:
A small clay lamp with an ochre felt shade glows warmly, its braided yarn pull cord still swinging from a tug.
A plush seal sits beneath it, looking up, flippers raised in a squeal of delight.
The mood is proud, cheerful control.
sock-fist:
Two plump closed felt tulips sit side by side, and one has just opened its petals to show a scrunched sage sock tucked inside.
A little knitted bunny sits in front of them, leaning toward the open one.
The mood is a happy guessing game.
half-hidden-toy:
A small wooden train engine in ochre sits with a soft lavender felt cloth draped over its back half, only its front and one wheel showing.
A tiny felt penguin waddles toward it, flipper stretched out to tug the cloth.
The mood is a gentle game of finding.
copy-cat-hands:
Two knitted frogs sit facing each other, a big sage one and a little cream one, both with their front legs up, mid-clap.
Faint pencil clap bursts pop between them, the little frog's a beat behind the big one's.
The mood is bouncy, copy-me fun.
big-tiny-voice:
A plush lion with a woolly mane sings with its mouth wide open, big bold pencil sound waves rolling out on one side, while on its other side a single thin, whispery curl drifts away.
A small felt cub sits close in front, looking up.
The mood is playful, big and small surprise.
point-and-name:
A small knitted giraffe stretches its long neck straight out, pointing across the rug at a little clay apple on the far edge.
A faint dotted line runs from its nose to the apple, and a tiny felt duckling beside it has just turned to look the same way.
The mood is calm, shared discovery.
window-movers:
A small wooden toy bus in sage rolls along the rug's edge, a faint dotted trail behind it.
A tiny paper bird flutters past above it.
A small felt deer sits in the middle, head turned to follow the bus.
The mood is quiet, watchful wonder.
up-up-down:
A felt hot-air balloon in ochre and cream stripes hovers above the rug, carrying a small felt piglet in its basket.
A faint dotted line shows it climbed up in three small steps, and a long swoop line waits below it.
The mood is grinning, giddy anticipation.
ring-ring-phone:
Two small clay toy telephones in sage and terracotta sit apart, joined by a long curly yarn cord.
A plush walrus holds one receiver to its ear, and a tiny felt chick holds the other, a little pencil sound curl drifting between them.
The mood is chatty, warm make-believe.
shake-and-stop:
A small cream clay cup with a felt lid stands perfectly still, a rolled lavender sock peeking through a gap at the top.
Faint shake lines around it have just stopped, and felt music notes hang frozen in the air above.
A small felt badger looks up at it, ears perked.
The mood is a held, giggly pause.
mirror-swap:
A small oval mirror in a painted wooden frame stands upright on the rug.
A plush bear and a tiny bear cub sit in front of it; in the glass the big bear pulls a slow puffed-cheek face, and the cub has just turned from the mirror to check the real bear beside it.
The mood is curious, giggly double-take.
knee-tunnel-gate:
Two soft sage cushions lean together to form a little arched tunnel on the rug, a flat wooden gate bar resting across its opening.
A small felt hedgehog waits at the entrance, nose forward, while a bright ochre felt ball waits on the far side.
The mood is eager, wiggly patience.
echo-chat:
Two clay whales face each other, a big sage one and a little cream calf, each with a matching pencil-drawn sound curl of exactly the same shape floating from its smile.
A third curl, slightly different, hangs in the air between them, waiting to be copied.
The mood is gentle, copy-me conversation.
cushion-peek-sides:
A big plump terracotta cushion stands on the rug, and a small knitted monkey pops out from its left side, ears first.
A faint dotted arc on the right side shows where it will pop out next.
The mood is bright, peekaboo surprise.
open-arms:
A big plush koala sits with both arms held wide open, waiting.
A tiny cream felt koala wobbles toward it across the rug, leaning forward mid-step, a short dotted trail behind it.
The mood is warm, waiting tenderness.
rattle-cup:
Two clay cups sit upside down side by side, one sage and one ochre.
The ochre one has faint pencil rattle lines around it, and a small felt raccoon nudges it so it tips, a little wooden bead toy peeking out from under the rim.
The mood is the happy click of a good guess.
nose-beep:
A plush lavender elephant sits low, and a tiny clay turtle stretches up to poke the round button at the end of its trunk, a small pencil spark popping out.
The elephant's floppy felt ear is lifted, a springy pencil zigzag beside it, the next button to press.
The mood is silly, giggly fun.
light-spot-hunt:
In soft dusk light, a round warm glow sits on the rug like a small pool of golden light, a fading trail showing where it slid from.
A small knitted octopus creeps toward it, one curly arm reaching out to touch it.
The mood is hushed, cosy bedtime wonder.
hallway-hide:
A long narrow knitted runner stretches across the rug like a little path, ending at a tall upright sage cushion.
A plush fox peeks out from behind the cushion, just its ears and one eye showing, while a tiny felt fox kit crawls along the runner toward it.
The mood is warm, playful chase.
rain-cup:
A small cream clay cup tips in mid-air, pouring a thin stream of clear glass beads onto the rug.
A small clay hippo sits in a shallow puddle of beads, looking up at the cup, and a dotted arc shows the cup about to move on.
The mood is splashy, sparkly fun.
so-big:
A small knitted monkey stands tall with both arms stretched as high as they go, a little burst of felt stars around it.
Beside it, a stitched line of dots climbs upward, the top dot glowing.
The mood is proud, joyful cheering.
splash-stop:
A small felt penguin stands at the edge of a little pool of clear glass beads, both flippers lifted high and frozen.
A few beads still hang in the air like splash drops, and the pool's ripples have gone still.
The mood is a giggly, splash-ready pause.
sound-around:
A small felt deer sits in the middle of the rug, head turned over its shoulder, ears pricked.
At the rug's edge, a tiny wooden clapper toy gives off a small pencil click burst, and a faint dotted path shows the click has moved around from the other side.
The mood is curious, searching delight.
tap-tap-turns:
An upside-down terracotta clay cup sits like a little drum in the middle of the rug.
A small wooden woodpecker leans in, its beak just tapping the cup, two little pencil tap marks popping off it, while a felt squirrel across from it waits its turn, paw raised.
The mood is rhythmic, chatty fun.
ready-steady-fly:
A small felt owlet rides a soft cloud of cream wool, lifted high above the rug, a long dotted arc showing its slow float up and gentle way back down.
Three stitched dots on the rug below, the last one tiny, mark the whispered count.
The mood is floating, whispery wonder.
song-stop-dance:
A knitted giraffe holding a tiny felt calf close is frozen mid-step on one leg, like a statue caught in its sway.
Felt music notes hang still in the air around them, and a faint dotted path shows the swaying dance behind.
The mood is a cheeky, swaying pause.
doorway-boo:
A tall folded cream felt screen stands on the rug, and a plush lion leans out from its lower edge, mane first, with a big grin.
A small felt lion cub sits in front, still looking up high where the lion appeared last time, marked by a faint dotted arc.
The mood is bright, peekaboo surprise.
creep-and-stop:
A small felt hedgehog scurries ahead across the rug, and behind it a big plush crocodile in sage creeps low, frozen like a statue mid-step.
A faint dotted trail shows both their paths curving across the rug.
The mood is giggly, sneaky chase.
three-things-tour:
Three tiny handmade things stand around the rug: a terracotta clay kettle, a sage felt plant in a clay pot and a small wooden window frame with a lavender felt sky.
A faint dotted pencil loop joins them. A grey felt koala has stopped beside the kettle, ears up, looking straight at it.
The mood is a slow, cosy tour, pausing to name each thing.
last-word-bounce:
A grey plush elephant holds a tiny knitted baby elephant snug against its chest, both frozen still at the top of a gentle bounce.
A short trail of ochre felt music notes arcs up beside them and stops, the last note hanging alone in the air.
The mood is a held breath before the rhyme starts again.
behind-my-back:
A rust felt fox stands sideways, and a small striped clay rattle peeks out from behind its back on the left side.
A cream knitted bunny sits facing it, eyes turned to the left, just about to reach. A dotted pencil circle around the bunny shows the fox's slow walk.
The mood is gentle surprise: there it is!
three-step-summit:
Three small wooden blocks stack up like little stairs, each step stitched with one more cream felt dot than the last.
A cream knitted lamb has just reached the top step and stands there proudly, one hoof raised.
The mood is a tiny, cheerful triumph at the summit.
mirror-vanish:
A small round mirror in a terracotta clay frame stands upright, its glass a soft silvery glow showing only an empty space.
Just beside it, out of the mirror's view, a felt penguin holds a tiny felt penguin chick, both leaning back in, ready to slide into view.
The mood is a playful hush: gone, and about to come back.
copy-the-crawler:
A large sage clay turtle and a tiny ochre clay turtle crawl side by side in exactly the same pose, each with the same front foot lifted.
Two matching dotted pencil trails curve behind them, step for step.
The mood is warm and tuned in, one copying the other.
hallway-roller:
A soft terracotta felt ball rolls slowly away across the rug, leaving a faint dotted trail behind it.
A yellow wooden duck on little wheels toddles after it, head tipped forward, eyes on the ball.
The mood is a happy, unhurried chase.
sofa-boing:
A plump ochre velvet cushion sits on the rug, and a small felt hedgehog crouches on it, perfectly still, ready to spring.
A long wavy pencil line stretches out from the cushion and curls on and on, the drawn-out sound before the jump.
The mood is giggly anticipation, waiting for the boing.
baby-says-go:
A small cream clay owl sits with its beak just open, one tiny pencil squeak mark floating above it.
In front of it a little sage wooden train stands stopped on a curl of track, wheels ready to roll the moment the owl makes a sound.
The mood is patient waiting, then go!
there-it-is:
A small wooden window frame stands upright with a pale lavender felt sky behind its panes, and a tiny felt bird glides past outside.
A small wooden giraffe stands in front of the window, long neck turned to follow the bird, a dotted pencil line tracing its flight.
The mood is quiet wonder at something going by.
sock-flight:
A cream wool sock rolled into a ball has just landed on the far side of the rug, at the end of a high dotted pencil arc.
A faint pencil circle marks the empty spot where it landed last time, and a russet felt squirrel is turning away from it toward the new spot.
The mood is light and curious: where did it land?
chair-tunnel:
A doll-sized wooden kitchen chair stands on the rug, its seat making a little tunnel underneath.
A small grey knitted mouse has just poked its head out from under the seat on the far side, ears wide. A dotted pencil path shows the crawl through.
The mood is a cheerful pop-out moment.
doorway-march:
A small wooden door frame stands on the rug, and a red felt toy drum sits beside it, its sticks resting.
A little wooden horse on wheels has stopped dead on the threshold, one hoof raised mid-march, while a trail of felt music notes behind it hangs paused.
The mood is a silly, stomping march caught in a hush.
lights-off-tour:
A small clay lamp with a cream felt shade sits on the rug, its warm glow just fading to dusk, beside a tiny wooden switch flipped down.
A small plush koala sits close by in the dimness, round eyes on the lamp, waiting for the light to come back.
The mood is a soft, waiting hush in the dark.
watch-me-wiggle:
A green knitted frog is frozen mid-wiggle, one leg kicked out and arms flung wide, little pencil wiggle lines stopped around it.
In front of it a tiny cream knitted lamb has turned its head away toward a felt ball.
The mood is silly and still, waiting to be watched again.
baby-steers:
A meandering dotted pencil path wanders across the rug past a clay lamp, a felt plant and a wooden spoon, with no straight line anywhere.
At the lamp, a small wooden giraffe stretches its long neck to nuzzle the clay shade.
The mood is calm and curious, following wherever the eyes go.
cushion-lap:
Three small felt cushions in sage, ochre and lavender sit in a row, and the middle one is lifted at one edge to show a yellow wooden duck tucked underneath.
A dotted pencil loop runs round the edge of the rug, the slow circuit just walked.
The mood is a happy find: which one?
teddy-big-day:
A small plush felt teddy bear in warm ochre sits at a tiny wooden table with a clay bowl and spoon, a napkin tucked under his chin.
Along the curve of the rug behind him wait the rest of his day: a tiny clay washbasin with a folded washcloth, then a little pillow with a knitted blanket.
The mood is a cozy little routine.
slow-quick-song:
On one side of the rug, a little paper boat leans on soft sage felt waves, with long lazy felt music notes drifting above it.
On the other side, small quick felt notes bounce close together in a bright cluster.
The mood is a playful switch between dreamy and lively.
which-sofa-end:
A doll-sized sofa of soft terracotta felt sits on the rug, and a rust felt fox peeks out from behind one armrest.
A brown felt hedgehog crawls along the front of the sofa toward the other armrest, the empty end.
The mood is giggly hide-and-seek.
light-spot-chase:
A small cream clay torch lies on its side, casting a round spot of soft warm light onto the rug.
A grey felt kitten crouches beside the spot, one paw lifted, about to pat it. A faint dotted trail shows where the spot crept from.
The mood is gentle, dim-lit wonder.
tower-chase:
Three stacked clay cups in terracotta, sage and cream are toppling mid-crash, the top cup hovering in the air.
On the far side of the rug a second neat stack of three cups stands waiting.
The mood is gleeful: ready, steady, crash!
page-walk:
An open felt picture book lies on the rug, one page showing a stitched picture of a cup.
Beside it stands a real little terracotta clay cup, and a dotted pencil line runs from the picture to the cup.
The mood is calm discovery: that one is this one.
hum-hunt:
A cream knitted bunny sits against a small ochre cushion, head turned all the way round to look behind it.
Soft pencil hum waves circle the cushion and gather in a little cluster right behind the bunny.
The mood is gentle and searching, then found.
listen-stops:
A small clay tap stands on the rug with one glass bead of water falling from its spout.
A grey felt badger is frozen mid-step, one ear turned toward the tap. Faint pencil sound ripples drift from the drip.
The mood is a still, careful listen.
catch-the-log:
A rolled-up sage knitted blanket lies like a log, with curved pencil marks showing it has just rolled one turn.
A small striped felt raccoon crawls toward it, one paw stretched out to touch.
The mood is a giggly, slow-motion chase.
slow-delivery:
A little clay snail carries a red felt ball on its shell, inching across the rug.
Its dotted trail shows two small pauses on the way. A grey plush elephant waits at the end, trunk curled up in hope.
The mood is delicious slowness, coming, coming.
drop-and-look:
A soft yellow felt star is frozen in mid-fall, a dotted pencil line tracing its drop.
Below, a black and cream felt penguin looks up, beak slightly open, caught in the uh-oh moment.
The mood is a small, warm pause before again.
cup-trio-hide:
Three upside-down clay cups in sage, cream and ochre stand in a row.
The end cup is tipped up at its rim, and a red felt ladybird toy peeks out from underneath, while the other two stay closed.
The mood is a bright little cheer: found it!
pocket-kiss-hand:
Two small lavender knitted mittens sit closed side by side, each one a tight little pouch.
One is just opening, and a tiny terracotta felt heart peeks out of it. A short line of felt music notes floats above.
The mood is tender, secret and sweet.
new-hiding-spot:
Two small felt cushions sit apart, one sage on the left, one ochre on the right.
A little wooden car slides along a slow dotted path from the left cushion to the right one, and the left cushion is tipped up, empty.
The mood is a clever moment: where now?
goodnight-room-dark:
A tiny clay lamp, a doll-sized wooden chair and a small brown teddy bear sit together in soft lavender dusk, the lamp switched off.
A felt crescent moon hangs above them, and faint pencil outlines trace each of the three things in the dark.
The mood is sleepy and hushed, goodnight.
two-in-the-picture:
An open felt picture book lies on the rug, its page busy with stitched trees, houses, a little dog and a red hat.
The little dog is ringed with a soft pencil circle, and the red hat waits, not yet found.
The mood is focused searching, one more to go.
pat-pat-copy:
Two small felt drums sit side by side, one ochre, one sage.
Above the first drum float two pencil pat marks, and above the second the same two marks are just appearing, echoing back.
The mood is a playful back and forth.
your-name-story:
A tiny wooden door stands ajar among sage felt flowers and clay toadstools, with warm light glowing through the gap.
A small grey felt mouse stands at the doorstep, one foot raised, about to go in.
The mood is a story paused at its most exciting bit.
today-in-order:
A row of tiny things runs across the rug, joined by a dotted pencil line: a felt sun rising, a clay breakfast bowl with a wooden spoon, an empty gap, then a clay dinner plate.
The empty gap in the middle of the line stands out.
The mood is cheeky: you forgot something!
mystery-hands-feel:
A small ochre knitted drawstring bag sits closed, a mystery toy making a round lump inside it.
A knitted lamb sits beside it with its eyes shut tight, one hoof tucked into the bag's opening, feeling.
The mood is curious guessing.
lumpy-blanket-hide:
A cream knitted blanket lies on the rug with one small round lump under it, perfectly still.
Nearby a rust felt fox peers into an upside-down clay cup, looking in completely the wrong place.
The mood is giggly, silly hide-and-seek.
hand-on-the-cup:
An upside-down terracotta clay cup sits on the rug with a toy tucked underneath.
A striped felt raccoon rests one paw flat on top of the cup, ears up, holding still. Three faint pencil dots hang above it, one by one.
The mood is wiggly patience, wait, wait, go.
three-two-one-hug:
A green knitted frog and a brown felt hedgehog stand a little apart, facing each other, arms open wide.
Between them, three stitched dots float in a row, two already faded.
The mood is warm, bubbling countdown to a hug.
piggy-pause-toes:
Five small pink clay piglets sit in a row, getting smaller from left to right.
The first four sit settled, and the last tiny piglet waits alone, frozen mid-wiggle, with a pencil hush mark above it.
The mood is a giggly hush before the wee wee wee.
finger-candle-blow:
A single small cream felt candle with a soft amber felt flame, the flame bending far to one side as if bowed by a long, slow breath.
Faint painted swirls of breath drift toward it from the left. Four more unlit felt candles stand in a row beside it, waiting their turn.
The mood is slow and calm, one whole breath at a time.
still-stone-mouse:
A smooth grey felt stone sits in the middle of the rug, perfectly still.
A small cream felt mouse creeps toward it on tiptoe, frozen mid-creep, almost there. A dotted trail behind it starts back at the rug's edge.
The mood is tense and silly stillness.
knee-bridge-ball:
A small wooden arch bridge stands on the rug, lowered flat and shut.
In front of it a pink clay pig waits beside a red felt ball, and a little pencil creak mark shows the bridge is about to lift.
The mood is patient waiting for open.
touch-the-bear:
A brown plush bear lies asleep on a sage felt cushion, curly pencil snore swirls drifting up from it.
A small felt squirrel has crept close and rests one tiny paw on the bear's paw.
The mood is cosy and funny, a quiet touch wakes the bear.
rug-tightrope-walk:
A single cream yarn line runs straight across the rug like a tightrope.
A felt penguin balances on it mid-step, wings stretched out wide. At the end of the line waits a soft lavender cushion.
The mood is careful, hushed concentration.
shy-sock-whisper:
A striped sage and cream sock puppet with button eyes peeks halfway out of a rolled knitted sleeve.
A small plush koala leans toward it, and tiny curly pencil whisper lines pass between them.
The mood is shy, soft and secret.
whisper-chat:
A small knitted bunny lies asleep under a scrap of lavender felt blanket.
On either side a clay owl and a rust felt fox lean in close, tiny curly whisper lines drifting between them over the sleeper.
The mood is hushed and conspiring.
toy-bedtime-tuck:
A soft cream cloth lies over the rug like a little bed, with three small toy shapes tucked under it.
Beside it a little sage wooden train is still awake, waiting its turn, and a felt crescent moon hangs above.
The mood is sleepy and tender, night night.
whisper-tent-rule:
A small knitted blanket is draped into a little tent shape on the rug.
A green knitted frog is halfway through the opening: tiny soft whisper curls float inside the tent, and big bold pencil sound lines burst outside.
The mood is a playful switch, quiet inside, loud outside.
tummy-drum-soft-loud:
A round ochre felt drum sits in the middle of the rug.
On one side a tiny felt mouse holds a little drumstick, and on the other a grey plush elephant raises its trunk high, both frozen with sticks up after stop.
The mood is giggly and bouncy, then still.
hum-and-stop:
A wooden giraffe and a sage clay turtle are frozen mid-sway, both leaning to one side.
A wavy pencil hum line runs above them and breaks off suddenly in empty air.
The mood is giggly freeze, waiting for the hum.
magic-word-song:
A ribbon of ochre felt music notes flows across the rug, and in the middle of them glows one small yellow felt star.
A cream clay owl sits beside it with both wings clapped over its beak.
The mood is a cheeky, held-in giggle.
rock-the-baby-tempo:
A little lavender knitted cradle rocks on curved wooden runners, a tiny felt bear tucked inside.
Above it, felt music notes drift from big to small, slowing and fading toward sleep.
The mood is soft, slow and lulling.
name-that-hum:
A small ochre felt songbird sits with its beak closed, a long wavy pencil hum line rising from it in a tune.
Across from it a green knitted frog tilts its head, listening hard.
The mood is cheerful, puzzled guessing.
animal-sound-swap:
A small cream wooden cow and a yellow wooden duck face each other on the rug.
Pencil sound marks burst from the cow, and a curved dotted arrow loops between them, showing it is about to switch.
The mood is noisy, silly and quick.
no-repeat-farm:
A row of tiny wooden farm animals stands along a felt fence: a cow, a pig, a sheep and a duck.
A second wooden cow has just trotted up to join the end of the line and stands there, caught out.
The mood is cheeky and sing-song: we had the cow!
turtle-rabbit-knee:
A soft sage felt hill rises on the rug.
A small clay turtle creeps up one side so slowly it barely moves, while a cream knitted rabbit hops up the other side, caught mid-hop.
The mood is playful, slow and fast at once.
baby-cup-mummy-cup:
A big terracotta clay cup wears a tiny knitted baby bonnet, and a small cream clay cup beside it wears a little felt apron.
Faint pencil giggle marks float above them.
The mood is silly and topsy-turvy.
nod-or-shake:
A sage clay owl is caught mid-shake, with little pencil motion lines on either side of its head.
Beside it sits a grey felt cat wearing silly paper bird wings.
The mood is giggly: no, a cat is not a bird!
nose-knees-toes:
A brown knitted monkey sits on the rug, one paw on its button nose and the other pointing up at its ear.
Little pencil star marks twinkle beside the nose and the ear, as if just touched.
The mood is quick and giggly, follow the words.
teddys-dinner-spoon:
A small brown teddy bear sits up on the rug before a cream clay cup and a little wooden spoon heaped with pretend felt porridge.
The bear's head is turned away from the spoon, full up.
The mood is warm, caring play.
doctor-kid-patient:
A grey plush elephant lies on its back with one leg wrapped in a cream cloth bandage.
Beside it rests a little felt toy doctor's kit, and a knitted bunny lies nearby with a tiny felt patch on its ear, also poorly.
The mood is gentle and caring.
face-copy-feelings:
Two round felt faces stand propped on little wooden stands, each with stitched features.
Both show the same face: wide round eyes and a round open mouth, surprised.
The mood is playful, guessing feelings together.
sleepy-mirror-slow:
Two plush sloths in sage and ochre lie side by side, both caught in the same slow yawn, one arm stretched up.
Soft pencil lines trail behind their arms to show the motion is very, very slow.
The mood is drowsy and dreamy.
sock-is-a-phone:
A striped terracotta and cream sock is curled into a snake on the rug, with button eyes and a stitched tongue.
Faint pencil outlines float around it of the other things it has been: a phone, a hat and a glove puppet.
The mood is silly, make-believe play.
little-seed-grow:
A tiny felt sprout pushes up from a clay pot, its first two leaves just opening.
Above it, a soft cream felt cloud drops glass-bead raindrops. Five stitched dots sit in a row beside the pot, three filled.
The mood is gentle, slow growing.
find-the-twin-sock:
Three mixed pairs of small knitted socks lie spread out on the rug: striped, spotty and plain.
One striped sock stands upright on a little wooden peg, and its striped twin lies among the others, just found.
The mood is a satisfying match.
fish-or-shark:
A soft blue-sage knitted blanket spreads like a sea with one small lump under it.
A little ochre felt fish pokes its head out from one edge, while a grey felt shark fin glides past on the far side.
The mood is giggly suspense.
shadow-zoo-wall:
A small standing paper screen glows warm, lit by a cream clay torch.
A sage felt crocodile puppet stands between them, and its long snapping shadow falls across the paper screen.
The mood is cosy, magical guessing.
light-it-up-torch:
A small cream clay torch lies on the rug, its soft beam landing on a tiny clay teapot.
Just beside it, a small wooden door stands in the dark, the thing it should have lit.
The mood is a cheeky miss, then the slide across.
ceiling-star-spot:
A brown felt hedgehog and a felt penguin lie on their backs side by side, looking up.
A small clay torch between them points upward, and a glowing spot like a soft yellow star hangs in the air above, with a dotted pencil trail where it glided.
The mood is calm and dreamy, watching the star.
what-can-you-hear:
A cream knitted bunny lies on its back in the middle of the rug, long ears spread out, stitched eyes closed.
Around it sit a little clay fridge, a wooden toy car and a felt sparrow, each sending faint pencil-drawn sound ripples toward the bunny.
The mood is hushed and still, listening together.
knee-door-knock:
Two tall ochre felt cushions lean together into a pointed arch, a closed little door with a tiny clay knob.
A sage felt hedgehog stands before it, one paw raised mid-knock, two small pencil-drawn knock marks beside the door.
The mood is the hopeful pause before the door creaks open.
beep-nose-buttons:
A rounded cream papier-mâché toy machine lies on its back with three clay buttons in terracotta, lavender and sage.
A small grey felt mouse stands on top, pressing the terracotta button down; a pencil zigzag beeps from it, and soft felt cloud puffs drift from the sage one.
The mood is giggly cause and effect, again and again.
give-and-take:
A plush lavender elephant holds a little wooden ring rattle out in its trunk toward a cream knitted lamb sitting opposite.
The lamb leans forward, one hoof lifted, waiting for the hand-over, a faint dotted pencil arc between them.
The mood is gentle back and forth: for you, thank you.
which-side-pop:
A plump sage velvet cushion stands upright like a small soft wall.
A terracotta felt fox pops up over its left edge, while a faint pencil arc on the right shows where it bobbed a moment ago.
The mood is bright surprise: boo, over here!
find-my-foot-blanket:
A small lavender knitted blanket covers a sleeping plush koala from ears to tail.
One corner is folded back to reveal just one round felt paw, wiggling, with little pencil wiggle lines beside it.
The mood is giggling discovery: found it!
peekaboo-faces-cloth:
A cream tea towel hangs from a little wooden peg stand, caught mid-drop and fluttering down.
Behind it a round clay owl is revealed, eyes huge and beak open in a big surprised O.
The mood is the magic of peekaboo, the instant of the reveal.
in-on-under-cup:
A terracotta clay cup stands on the rug, and a rolled cream wool sock sits balanced right on top of it.
A faint dotted pencil path loops from inside the cup, under its edge and round behind it, tracing where the sock has been.
A small yellow wooden duck watches.
The mood is curious and playful.
cloth-riddle-guess:
A sage tea towel drapes over a hidden toy, its lumpy shape showing one small wooden wheel peeking out at the hem.
Beside it an ochre felt squirrel tilts its head, thinking hard, a small pencil-drawn thought cloud above it.
The mood is puzzling it out, one clue at a time.
scarf-up-scarf-down:
A long lavender knitted scarf has just floated down and lies in soft loops on the rug.
Beside it a small felt penguin is frozen mid-dance like a statue, one flipper up, leaning to one side, its pencil motion lines stopping short.
The mood is wiggly fun caught in a sudden freeze.
teddys-turn-tower:
A half-built tower of three wooden blocks in ochre, sage and cream.
A brown felt bear sits beside it, one paw lifting a fourth block that hovers just above the top, while a cream knitted bunny waits, its own block resting in front.
The mood is patient turn-taking: whose turn is it?
shy-tortoise-feet:
A cream knitted blanket lies in a soft mound.
Two little sage clay turtles creep out from under its edge: one is caught halfway out, head stretched, the other has just ducked back so only its shell rim shows.
The mood is shy and sneaky, a giggle held in.
open-shut-them:
A small knitted octopus in dusty lavender sits on the rug, two arms spread wide open, two curled shut.
One arm creeps slowly upward and stops just short of its chin, frozen there.
A few felt music notes float softly above.
The mood is slow and cosy, a gentle wind-down.
fill-the-rhyme:
A small ochre clay hen sits with her beak wide open, about to sing.
Beside her a little wooden music box sends a line of felt music notes drifting across the rug, ending in one empty gap where the last note should be.
The mood is the waiting pause before the missing word.
same-or-different:
Two small socks hang side by side from a tiny wooden peg stand: one with ochre stripes, one with sage spots.
A soft heap of more socks lies below, and a felt hedgehog looks up from one sock to the other.
The mood is careful looking: same or different?
wash-then-dry:
A brown felt bear with a few muddy felt splotches sits in a small clay basin of pale glass-bead water.
Beside it a folded cream tea towel waits its turn, with a tiny wooden scrubbing brush.
The mood is busy and proud: wash first, then dry.
one-finger-wiggle:
Five small wooden peg skittles stand in a neat row, painted ochre, sage, cream, lavender and terracotta.
Four stand still as stones beside a smooth grey pebble; only the lavender one wobbles, with tiny pencil wiggle lines around it.
The mood is careful stillness with one small wiggle.
you-say-three:
A brown knitted monkey sits on a plump felt cushion, caught at the top of a small bounce, a dotted pencil arc beneath it.
On the rug beside it, two stitched dots in a row and an empty space where a third should go.
The mood is breathless waiting before the biggest bounce.
please-puppet:
A cream wool sock puppet with button eyes and a felt mouth holds a small wooden toy car tightly in its mouth.
A grey felt raccoon sits in front of it, paws together, about to ask nicely.
The mood is the polite pause before the toy drops free.
pass-the-kiss:
A plush lavender elephant and a cream knitted bunny sit side by side on the rug.
A tiny terracotta felt heart floats between them along a dotted pencil path, just leaving the elephant's trunk.
The mood is tender and warm, the end of the day.
cushion-shuffle:
Three plump cushions lie in a row in sage, ochre and lavender.
The ochre one is tipped up at one corner, and a small wooden train engine peeks out from underneath.
Curved pencil arrows show the two outer cushions just slid past each other.
The mood is the gasp of finding it.
two-sock-piles:
Two neat piles of small knitted socks: one of dark socks in deep sage, plum and charcoal, one of light socks in cream, pale yellow and powder blue.
Between them, a small jumbled heap of mixed socks, and one striped sock floating just above it on its way to a pile.
The mood is the calm pleasure of putting things where they belong.
two-things-fetch:
A small woven basket at the rug's edge holds a terracotta clay cup and a yellow wooden duck, both just delivered.
A dotted pencil trail winds in to it, and a terracotta felt fox sits beside the basket, looking proud.
The mood is mission accomplished.
slow-motion-me:
A plush sage sloth raises one long arm in a stretch, frozen halfway, faint pencil lines showing its slow path.
Beside it a little clay snail lifts its head just as slowly, and a small jar of ochre clay honey sits nearby.
The mood is slow and calm, moving through honey.
cat-bear-switch:
A lavender felt cat creeps on tiptoe across the rug, leaving tiny faint dotted prints.
Behind it a chunky brown felt bear is caught mid-stomp, one leg lifted high, with big round prints and pencil stomp lines below.
The mood is playful switching, quiet then loud.
teddy-cafe-order:
A cream knitted puppy carries a little wooden tray holding a terracotta clay cup with a curl of felt steam.
Back at the far edge of the rug, a small felt banana lies forgotten.
The mood is busy and proud: the order is on its way.
who-ran-away:
A pink clay pig and a wooden giraffe stand in a row, with an empty space between them marked by a faint dotted outline.
Behind a small sage cushion nearby, one wheel of a little wooden car peeks out.
The mood is curious and puzzled: who ran away?
tower-on-three:
A tall wobbly tower of five clay cups in sage, ochre, cream, lavender and terracotta stands perfectly still.
A grey felt badger sits waiting beside it, paws together, and two stitched dots on the rug count toward a third.
The mood is the delicious wait before the crash.
speedy-sleepy-song:
A little wooden music box sends out a spiral of felt music notes, packed close and quick at first, then spreading out and drifting slowly down.
At the end of the spiral a cream knitted lamb has curled up asleep under a small felt moon.
The mood is winding down, fast to slow.
wait-wait-go:
A brown felt otter sits holding a striped ochre and cream knitted ball against its chest, perfectly still.
A faint dotted pencil line runs across the open rug ahead, the path the ball is about to roll.
The mood is held-breath waiting for go.
warm-cold-hunt:
A small grey felt mouse creeps toward a lavender cushion, behind which a little wooden horse is half hidden.
The rug glows warm amber near the cushion and fades to tiny pale blue felt snowflakes near the far edge.
The mood is getting warmer, almost there.
two-homes-tidy:
Two little homes sit on the rug: a woven basket of wooden blocks and a soft felt nest full of plush toys.
One block sits wrongly in the soft nest, tilted, while an ochre felt squirrel carries another block toward the basket.
The mood is a cheerful tidy-up.
cup-drum-turns:
Two terracotta clay cups sit upside down like little drums.
A wooden spoon rests on one, with faint pencil beat lines drifting up from it; the other is silent, and a green knitted frog sits beside it, waiting.
The mood is my turn, your turn.
sock-bowling-reset:
A sage clay cup lies tipped over at the far end of the rug, a rolled cream sock resting beside it.
A dotted pencil line traces the sock's low roll from the near edge, and a felt penguin waddles over to stand the cup back up.
The mood is proud and ready to go again.
behind-my-back-toddler:
A plump ochre cushion stands upright.
A small wooden car sits in front of it, set aside as the wrong one, while a little knitted whale in dusty blue is half drawn out from behind the cushion.
The mood is a sly trick and a cheerful reveal.
simon-says-two:
A small felt panda stands with one paw touching its own nose.
A dotted pencil arrow leads from it to a pair of little ochre clay cymbals waiting on the rug, the next action.
The mood is focused and playful, one thing then the next.
turtle-rabbit-lines:
A sheet of cream paper lies on the rug with two crayon lines: one slow, careful wavy line and one quick zigzag streak.
A sage clay turtle sits at the end of the slow line and a lavender felt hare at the end of the fast one, two chunky crayons beside them.
The mood is slow, then fast.
mirror-twins:
A small round mirror in a carved wooden frame stands propped on the rug.
In front of it a green knitted frog opens its mouth in a big round surprise, and its reflection makes exactly the same face back.
The mood is delighted copying.
follow-my-finger:
A tiny felt firefly with a soft warm glow loops through the air along a dotted pencil path, just landing on a small wooden toy boat.
A felt fawn sits nearby, head tilted, eyes following it.
The mood is calm, focused watching.
ring-ring-calls:
A grey felt raccoon and a cream knitted puppy sit facing each other, each holding a small wooden block to its ear like a phone.
Little pencil ring wiggles drift from the raccoon's block while the puppy listens, waiting to answer.
The mood is chatty and warm.
one-more-stop:
A plump terracotta cushion shows one fresh round dent, with pencil thump lines frozen around it.
Beside it a plush koala sits perfectly still, paws folded in front.
The mood is the hush right after the last thump.
spoon-bell-snack:
A small sage clay cup sits upside down over a hidden treat, the edge of a red felt strawberry peeking out.
A wooden spoon taps the rug beside it, with two tiny pencil chime marks, and a grey felt mouse waits very still nearby.
The mood is waiting for the bell.
cloth-present-wait:
A sage towel is wrapped around a lumpy toy and tied with a cream yarn bow.
Beside it a grey felt seal sits with its back to the present, flippers over its eyes, and a row of stitched dots runs along the rug toward it.
The mood is no peeking, almost time.
look-and-name:
A plush lavender elephant sits with its head and trunk turned toward a little wooden toy boat across the rug.
A faint dotted pencil sightline links the elephant to the boat.
The mood is shared attention: look, there it is.
window-spotter:
A small felt robin perches on a wooden peg, gazing toward the rug's edge, where a little terracotta wooden car is just rolling into view.
A felt cloud overhead drips cream glass-bead raindrops.
The mood is patient watching and a happy there!
page-patrol:
An open cloth picture book lies on the rug, its pages fanned so a stitched felt moon shows on each one.
A felt hedgehog leans over the newest page, nose pointing right at the moon.
The mood is the joy of finding it again.
what-comes-next:
An open fabric storybook lies on the rug, one page lifted halfway, about to turn.
A small plush lion in soft ochre leans toward it beside a clay lamp with a warm golden glow.
The mood is cosy bedtime anticipation: what comes next?
loud-soft-singing:
A little felt songbird sits with its beak wide open.
On one side of it large bold felt music notes burst upward; on the other, tiny ones barely float above the rug.
The mood is playful, from big and loud to a whisper.
cup-hat-pretend:
A terracotta clay cup sits upside down on the head of a green knitted frog like a hat.
Around them, faint pencil sketches show the same cup as a boat on felt waves and as a little car with wheels.
The mood is playful make-believe.
what-next-tower:
A crooked half-built tower of mismatched wooden blocks, a clay cup balanced at an angle on top.
A few spare blocks lie scattered, and a grey felt badger nudges one toward the base, working it out alone.
The mood is proud, I did it myself.
something-soft-fetch:
A little pile on the rug: a fluffy cream pom-pom, a red felt apple, a round wooden ball and a tiny clay bell.
A cream knitted puppy trots up carrying one more soft thing, a felt leaf, along a dotted pencil trail.
The mood is busy, happy collecting.
still-water-bath:
A small clay tub is filled with pale blue glass-bead water, smooth and flat as glass.
A yellow wooden duck floats perfectly still in the middle, and faint felt ripples fade away at the rim.
The mood is hushed calm after the splash.
spotlight-fetch:
The rug is dim, and a small clay lantern casts one soft warm circle of light on it.
Inside the circle sits a little wooden horse; at the circle's edge a felt penguin waits to step in.
The mood is hushed, glowing anticipation.
robot-parent:
A boxy ochre papier-mâché toy robot stands very straight and stiff, clay bolt buttons on its chest.
A brown knitted monkey sits beside it, one arm pointing to a small sage cushion, giving the next order.
The mood is funny and bossy.
show-and-name:
A wooden ring rattle, a felt leaf and a clay spoon lie in a loose row on the rug.
A cream knitted lamb holds one more thing, a small felt flower, out toward the open space beside them, offering it.
The mood is bright, curious sharing.
upside-down-sort:
A big ochre clay cup is stuffed with tiny socks, and a small sage clay cup has one big striped sock squashed into it, spilling comically over the rim.
A few more socks wait in a soft heap.
The mood is silly and upside down.
sound-effects-story:
An open fabric storybook lies on the rug.
A cream felt cow with ochre patches stands on one side, caught mid-moo with pencil sound curls drifting from it, while a cream knitted puppy waits its turn on the other.
The mood is lively, noisy storytelling.
you-be-me:
A large plush lavender elephant lies curled under a small knitted blanket, tucked in right up to its trunk.
A tiny clay owl stands beside it looking very bossy, holding a little cloth book.
The mood is playful role-swap: time for bed.
roll-to-teddy:
A brown felt bear sits propped up on the rug, arms open, waiting for its turn.
A striped ochre and sage knitted ball rolls toward it along a dotted pencil path, caught halfway across.
The mood is gentle, happy rolling.
page-turner-wait:
An open fabric book lies on the rug, one page corner lifted and held perfectly still mid-turn.
A felt fawn sits beside it, its nose resting on the corner, waiting.
The mood is patient: not yet, not yet, turn.
peek-and-pick:
Three odd socks lie in a row on the rug: ochre stripes, sage spots, plain lavender.
A little cream cloth beside them covers one more sock, just its striped toe peeking from under the edge.
The mood is a quiet little puzzle: which one is it?
secret-keeper:
A brown felt otter sits very still, paws pressed together, trying hard not to look.
Behind a sage cushion nearby, the back of a little wooden train peeks out.
The mood is a secret bursting to get out.
copy-tower-cloth:
Two little towers stand side by side: one hidden under a draped cream cloth, the shape of three blocks showing through.
Beside it a matching tower of wooden blocks is being built, two in place and the third hovering above.
The mood is careful remembering.
teddy-queue-turns:
A pink clay pig and a felt panda sit side by side in a row.
A tiny terracotta clay cup tips toward the panda for a sip, and a dotted pencil line shows it has already visited the pig.
The mood is fair and orderly: who is next?
red-light-whisper:
A little wooden toy car has stopped beside a tiny clay traffic light, its terracotta red lamp softly glowing.
Faint pencil whisper curls drift from the car's window.
The mood is a hushed, giggly pause.
pass-on-the-beat:
A terracotta felt fox and a sage clay turtle sit facing each other.
A striped knitted ball is caught mid-pass between them, with felt music notes drifting along above it.
The mood is rhythmic and steady, pass on the beat.
three-splashes:
A small clay tub of pale blue glass-bead water has three bead splashes frozen in the air above it.
Beside it a grey felt seal holds its flippers high, and three stitched dots sit on the rug.
The mood is splashy fun, then a sudden hold.
odd-sock-out:
Three socks lie in a row: two with matching sage stripes and one with terracotta spots, nudged slightly apart.
A grey felt raccoon peers closely at the spotted one.
The mood is a little detective moment: that one is different.
whisper-feet:
A small grey felt mouse creeps on tiptoe along a trail of tiny dotted prints.
Ahead, the trail turns into big round stomp prints with pencil thump lines.
A few faint whisper curls float above the mouse.
The mood is playful switching, quiet then loud.
line-them-up:
A small plush lion, a wooden toy car and a little clay boat stand in a neat row left to right.
The boat at the end sits slightly crooked, nudged out of line, waiting to be fixed.
The mood is tidy and satisfied.
red-means-clap:
A brown felt otter holds two small ochre clay cymbals apart, perfectly still.
In front of it sit a terracotta red felt apple and a dusty blue clay cup, and the otter is looking at the blue cup.
The mood is careful attention: only red means clap.
tell-teddy:
A small knitted teddy bear in ochre sits at the far edge of the rug, head tilted, listening hard.
At the near edge a tiny cream felt mouse leans toward it, and a row of faint pencil-drawn dots drifts between them, carrying a whispered message across.
The mood is hushed and secret: a message on its way.
ready-sock:
A rolled sage wool sock rests at one edge of the rug, perfectly still, a faint pencil arc in front of it showing where it is about to slide.
Across from it a little felt fox in terracotta sits upright, mouth open, ears pricked, just about to give the signal.
The mood is held breath, waiting for the word.
backwards-steps:
A small knitted bunny in lavender walks backwards toward a plump cream cushion, frozen mid-step with one paw lifted.
Behind it runs a trail of stitched pawprints, a tiny pebble beside each one counting the steps so far.
The mood is careful and giggly: freeze!
does-it-roll:
A wooden spool is mid-roll across the rug, a faint pencil trail curling behind it.
On a small sage cushion sit the rollers, a wooden ball and a clay wheel, and beside it lies a little pile that did not roll: a felt block, a knitted cube and a clay star.
The mood is curious testing.
build-what-i-say:
A half-built tower of felt-covered blocks, one terracotta then one sage, with a third terracotta block hovering just above it.
Beside it two small piles of blocks sorted by colour, and a little clay owl watching closely.
The mood is focused listening, one block at a time.
pat-the-moo:
Three handmade toys sit in a neat row: a plush cream cow with ochre spots, a small terracotta wooden car and a knitted lamb.
Faint pencil sound ripples rise from the cow alone, and a soft dent in the rug in front of it shows the right one was just patted.
The mood is a happy guess: that one!
elbows-only:
A few rolled wool socks in cream, sage and lavender lie scattered on the rug.
A small felt hedgehog balances one sock on top of its head, tiny paws held stiffly behind its back, wobbling as it tries not to grab.
The mood is wobbly concentration.
wrong-song:
A knitted songbird in ochre perches on a tiny felt branch, beak open, pencil-drawn music notes drifting out.
Among the notes floats one small lavender sock, clearly out of place, and a felt hen below flaps up in mock outrage.
The mood is silly delight at a mistake.
say-then-go:
A small felt penguin stands at one edge of the rug, one flipper pointing at a little sage felt flag planted at the far edge.
A faint pencil speech swirl hangs above its beak, and it has not taken a single step yet.
The mood is think first, then go.
back-where-it-was:
A small terracotta wooden car sits in an odd spot, perched on top of a felt mushroom.
Nearby, a faint stitched outline on the rug marks its usual home, empty, between a clay ball and a wooden block that sit where they always do.
The mood is a puzzle for sharp eyes.
zipped-lips:
A small grey-lavender felt mouse with a tiny stitched zip across its mouth walks a stitched dashed path beside a slow clay snail.
Faint pencil squiggles of silly noises float above them, and a little wooden arch waits at the far end of the path.
The mood is bursting-to-giggle silence.
nose-first:
A plush cream elephant walks across the rug with its trunk stretched far forward, leading the way, the rest of it trailing behind.
A faint dotted path shows the route, bending halfway where the leader changes.
The mood is silly and proud.
behind-you:
A small clay owl sits facing out, its back to a little cluster of things: a felt ball, a wooden block and a knitted flower.
Its head is mid-turn, peeking over its shoulder to check what is there.
The mood is the moment of checking: was I right?
green-means-go:
Two round felt signs on little sticks stand at the side of the rug, one sage and one terracotta, and the terracotta one is raised.
A small wooden duck on wheels has stopped dead halfway across, tipped forward, a puff of felt dust behind it.
The mood is a sudden, giggly stop.
chase-and-freeze:
A felt fox and a knitted bunny are frozen mid-chase like statues, the fox's paws stretched out, the bunny just ahead in mid-hop.
Three small pebbles in a row beside them count the slow pause.
The mood is giggly stillness before the chase goes on.
snail-and-rocket:
On one side of the rug an ochre clay snail creeps along, leaving a long slow trail.
On the other side a small papier-mache rocket in terracotta and cream whooshes the other way, puffs of felt smoke behind it.
The mood is slow and fast at once.
chair-tunnels:
Three little arched wooden blocks stand in a row to make a tunnel, and a small knitted lamb is halfway through, head poking out of the middle arch.
A plump sage cushion waits at the far end as the finish.
The mood is a small brave adventure.
silly-walk-leader:
A felt penguin waddles along the rug tipped far to one side, one flipper flung out.
Right behind it a little clay pig copies the exact same tilt and the same flung-out leg.
The mood is silly follow-the-leader.
jump-jump-freeze:
A knitted frog in sage hangs frozen in mid-air just above the rug, legs tucked, with two faint pencil arcs showing its last jumps.
Three stitched dots beside it count the hops.
The mood is bouncy, then perfectly still.
dance-till-it-stops:
A felt hedgehog is frozen mid-twirl, one paw high in the air, the other on its hip.
Beside it a little wooden music box sits with its lid just shut, pencil music notes hanging still in the air above it.
The mood is frozen mid-move, waiting for the music.
sock-delivery:
Two terracotta clay cups are filled to the brim with rolled wool socks, one sock teetering on the very top.
A small clay turtle carries one cup on its shell, walking slowly toward a plump cream cushion.
The mood is careful, steady carrying.
clap-statues:
A small plush teddy bear is frozen in a funny shape, balanced on one leg with both arms flung wide.
Beside it lies a pair of wooden clappers, just struck, a faint pencil burst above them.
The mood is wild, then suddenly still.
run-to-the-door:
A tiny painted wooden door in its own little frame stands at the far edge of the rug.
A felt squirrel and a knitted dog race toward it side by side, the squirrel just reaching out to touch it first.
The mood is a happy race.
terrible-hider:
A felt cat hides behind a small cream cushion, but its ochre tail sticks out one side and both ears poke over the top.
Faint pencil dots float up from behind the cushion, as if it is counting out loud.
The mood is giggling at a terrible hiding spot.
airplane-landing:
A small papier-mache aeroplane in cream and terracotta glides down toward a plump lavender cushion, a felt mouse pilot peering over its edge.
A dotted pencil flight path loops behind it around the rug.
The mood is a gentle touchdown.
stair-counter:
A little staircase of stacked wooden blocks climbs five steps, a small pebble resting on each step already climbed.
A clay turtle pauses on the third step, looking back down at how far it has come.
The mood is a proud pause halfway up.
hallway-relay:
A long stitched path runs across the rug, and at its far end wait a small clay cup and a wooden spinning top.
A felt hedgehog dashes back along the path carrying a rolled sage sock.
The mood is busy, happy fetching.
clap-new-animal:
A plush elephant is caught mid-stomp, trunk raised, and right beside it a knitted frog is caught mid-leap.
A faint pencil clap burst hangs between them, marking the instant one animal turned into the other.
The mood is a quick silly switch.
feet-follow-claps:
A line of stitched pawprints crosses the rug, far apart at one end and bunched tight at the other, each with a small pencil clap burst above it.
A wooden duck on wheels follows the prints, right on the beat.
The mood is keeping the rhythm.
cup-drum-parade:
An upside-down terracotta clay cup sits as a drum, two small wooden sticks resting still on top.
Behind it a felt penguin and a knitted lamb stand in a parade line, both frozen mid-march with one leg up.
The mood is the band that suddenly stops.
stop-at-the-cushion:
A plump sage cushion sits in the middle of the rug.
A felt fox has just skidded to a halt with its front paws touching the cushion's edge, a puff of felt dust and a pencil skid line behind it.
The mood is just in time.
big-tiny-steps:
A trail crosses the rug: big stitched pawprints spaced wide apart, then tiny ones packed close together, a small pebble beside each.
A tall wooden giraffe stands mid-stride at the big end, and a felt ladybird tiptoes at the tiny end.
The mood is counting, giant and tiny.
roll-wait-go:
A cream felt ball has just rolled to a stop near the rug's edge, a faint pencil trail behind it.
At the other end a knitted dog crouches low, ready, not moving yet.
The mood is the wait before go.
leg-tunnel:
A tall wooden arch stands open on the rug like a tunnel.
A small felt badger is crawling halfway through it, nose out the far side.
The mood is a quick crawl before the tunnel closes.
cushion-lava:
Small cushions in sage, cream and lavender are scattered across the rug as stepping stones, with felt lava in terracotta and amber flowing between them.
A knitted bunny is caught mid-hop from one cushion to the next.
The mood is a thrilling leap over the lava.
blanket-parachute:
A small knitted blanket in lavender and cream billows up into a soft dome, floating just above the rug.
Under its edge a little clay owl peeks out from the cosy tent beneath.
The mood is a big whoosh, then a hush.
cloth-river:
A strip of blue-grey felt scarf lies across the rug as a thin river, glass bead droplets along it.
A small knitted frog is caught mid-leap over it, high above the water.
The mood is a big, brave jump.
whoa-horse:
A small felt horse in ochre has stopped dead, front hooves planted, mane flying forward.
A tiny clay bird perches on its back, wings out as if calling it to halt.
The mood is whoa!
elevator-up:
A tower of three stacked wooden boxes stands like a little building, and beside it a small wooden lift box hangs on a string.
A clay pig rides inside, stopped at the second floor, and a tiny brass bell beside it has just rung.
The mood is ding, we have arrived.
wake-the-bear:
A plump plush bear in ochre lies asleep on its side, pencil swirls of snores rising, a rolled cream sock beside its paw.
A small felt fox is frozen mid-tiptoe, reaching toward the sock.
The mood is tense, giggly sneaking.
bridge-and-log:
A small arched wooden bridge stands beside a felt log lying flat on the rug.
A felt squirrel is crawling under the bridge, glancing at the log it must step over next.
The mood is under or over?
spot-chase:
A round spot of soft warm light glows on the rug, cast by a small papier-mache torch lying at the edge.
A felt kitten is mid-pounce, one paw lifted just above the glowing spot.
The mood is chasing the glow.
opposite-day:
A tall wooden giraffe stretches its neck high, and beside it a small clay turtle tucks itself flat and low.
Above them two pencil arrows, one up and one down, have swapped places.
The mood is topsy-turvy fun.
room-train:
A small wooden train, an engine and two carriages, chugs along a stitched track that loops around the rug, cream felt puffs of smoke above it.
It has just pulled into a tiny felt platform and stopped.
The mood is all aboard: where next?
pop-and-flop:
A felt weasel has flopped backwards onto a plump lavender cushion, arms flung wide.
Pencil music notes trail behind it from where it was marching, the last note bursting like a pop.
The mood is march, march, flop!
banana-kick:
A soft cream felt ball sits ready beside a small felt deer.
In a row nearby lie a felt apple, a felt carrot, a wedge of felt cheese and, last of all, a little felt banana.
The mood is waiting for the magic word.
round-the-sofa:
A large plump ochre cushion sits in the middle of the rug, a stitched looping track around it.
A felt squirrel and a knitted lamb run the loop, the squirrel caught mid-turn, switching direction.
The mood is round and round, then switch!
three-sock-hunt:
A terracotta clay cup holds one rolled sock.
Two more socks peek out from easy hiding spots: one under the corner of a cushion, one behind a wooden block.
Three stitched dots on the cup's side keep count.
The mood is a small treasure hunt.
sleepy-animals:
A small felt frog lies curled asleep on a sage cushion, eyes stitched shut.
Beside it five pebbles sit in a row, four of them dim and the last one softly glowing, the moment just before it wakes and hops.
The mood is sleepy stillness about to burst.
carry-the-word:
A long stitched path runs across the rug, a small seashell for listening at one end.
A felt hare races along it carrying a little round felt pancake, a pencil shout burst above it.
The mood is run, shout, run home.
singing-carpet:
A tiny knitted blanket glides across the rug like a magic carpet, its corners curling up.
A clay sparrow sits in the middle, beak open, pencil music notes streaming behind it.
The mood is sing to ride.
sock-on-me:
A felt raccoon in grey and cream has a rolled lavender sock tucked half under its arm, mostly hidden.
A faint pencil question swirl floats above it, as if someone is about to search.
The mood is playful hide and seek.
tug-and-stop:
A small striped towel in sage and cream lies slack between a felt badger and a clay piglet, each still holding one end.
Three pebbles beside them count the pause before the next pull.
The mood is still, then pull!
copy-my-path:
Three small cushions in sage, cream and lavender sit in a loose triangle on the rug.
Pencil-dotted hop arcs link two of them, and a felt grasshopper lands on the second, following the same path.
The mood is same path, same order.
cushion-nest:
Small cushions in sage, cream and terracotta are piled in a round nest at one edge of the rug.
Two little felt birds snuggle inside, and one more cushion waits nearby to be added.
The mood is cosy building together.
knock-at-every-door:
A small wooden doorway stands free on the rug, its door ajar.
A wooden duck on wheels has stopped right at the threshold, and three stitched dots beside the frame show three knocks.
The mood is stop, knock, then go.
name-the-chaser:
A knitted dog and a felt hen are mid-switch: the dog has just turned to run, and the hen is setting off after it.
A faint pencil loop shows the path they were chasing a moment ago, the other way round.
The mood is a quick swap of roles.
bear-hunt-walk:
A tiny path winds across the rug: tufts of felt grass, a river of glass beads, a lump of brown clay mud.
At the end a small plush bear peeks out of a felt cave.
The mood is thrilling story-walk suspense.
bridge-falls-down:
A small wooden arch bridge is caught mid-collapse, its two halves tipping down toward each other.
A felt mouse is just darting out from under it, pencil music notes swirling above.
The mood is will it catch me?
lights-out:
A small papier-mache lamp has just switched off, the last bit of warm glow fading, and the rug lies in soft dimness.
A knitted lion is frozen mid-roar, a faint pencil hush curl floating in front of it.
The mood is from roar to whisper.
cloud-catch:
A lavender scarf floats high above the rug like a soft cloud, mid-fall, a faint pencil arc showing how high it was thrown.
Below, a small felt monkey reaches up, ready to catch it before it lands.
The mood is a hopeful upward look.
creep-up-on-me:
A tall wooden giraffe stands at the far edge of the rug, facing away.
Behind it a felt weasel is frozen mid-creep, one paw lifted, a trail of tiptoe dots behind it.
The mood is sneaky, shhh.
sock-rain:
Rolled wool socks in cream, sage and lavender arc up into the air above the rug like falling rain.
Below, a terracotta clay cup sits half full, a few socks already tucked back in.
The mood is messy fun that ends tidy.
slowest-wins:
A clay snail and a clay turtle inch across the rug side by side, a stitched start line just behind them.
Faint pencil lines show how little they have moved.
The mood is a hilariously slow race.
hungry-sofa:
Two small papier-mache creatures with wide open mouths sit at opposite edges of the rug.
One is gobbling rolled socks, the other wooden blocks, and a mixed pile of both waits in the middle.
The mood is busy, giggly sorting.
sock-says:
An ochre sock puppet with button eyes and a felt mouth stands upright on the rug, mouth wide as if giving an order.
In front of it a small felt deer is caught mid-jump, obeying.
The mood is only the puppet decides.
run-and-stack:
A half-built tower of clay cups and wooden blocks stands at one edge of the rug, one block hovering just above the top.
At the far end a small pile waits, and a felt hedgehog hurries back carrying a cup.
The mood is careful turns, run and build.
whisper-chase:
A knitted lamb tiptoes after a small felt chick, both moving softly across the rug.
Faint pencil whisper swirls drift around them, and a crescent felt moon lies nearby.
The mood is a hushed, giggly chase.
run-home:
Two small cushions, one sage and one lavender, sit in opposite corners of the rug.
A clay pig and a felt penguin race in different directions, each heading for its own cushion.
The mood is a happy dash home.
find-the-song:
A little wooden music box is half hidden behind a cream cushion, pencil music notes drifting out.
A knitted elephant creeps toward it, one big ear turned forward to listen.
The mood is following the sound.
cat-and-mouse:
A rolled-up cream wool sock has become a mouse: two tiny felt ears, a stitched dot nose and a short curling yarn tail. It has just stopped moving, frozen mid-scurry.
Across from it, a small plush felt cat in warm ochre crouches low, bottom up, tail curled, eyes wide and fixed on the mouse, one paw lifted, waiting for the mouse to move.
A faint dotted trail on the rug shows the path the mouse just wiggled along.
The mood is playful suspense: the instant of waiting before the pounce.
high-five-hunt:
A small cream knitted mitten stands upright on a wooden peg, open and flat like a target, and a little sage knitted bunny is mid-leap toward it, one paw stretched out to slap it.
A second terracotta mitten nearby is curled shut, and a dotted pencil trail loops between the two.
The mood is giddy chasing and a sudden happy stop.
step-in-my-steps:
Three large ochre felt paw prints are laid across the rug in a big zigzag stride.
A small terracotta felt fox balances inside the second print, one paw lifted toward the third, careful to land exactly in it.
A faint pencil arc shows the hop it just made.
The mood is careful copying, one big step at a time.
swap-hands:
Two small terracotta clay cups each hold a rolled cream wool sock.
One cup floats mid-swap along a pencil-drawn arc from left to right, its sock wobbling at the rim but not falling out.
A small wooden duck on wheels trundles along beside them.
The mood is brisk and wobbly, a swap without a spill.
rescue-teddy:
A small honey felt teddy bear sits stranded on top of a tall stack of two lavender cushions.
A sage cushion lies in front like a hill, and a dotted pencil path runs over it and up the stack.
A tiny knitted frog waits at the start of the path, ready to climb.
The mood is a brave little rescue plan.
human-mountain:
A soft knitted mountain in sage and cream rises from the rug, gently rounded like something asleep.
A tiny felt mouse in an ochre scarf climbs near the summit, a little cloth flag on a stick tucked under one arm.
Faint pencil rumble lines shiver around the peak.
The mood is a whispered expedition about to get a giggle.
sleepy-lion:
A plush ochre lion with a shaggy yarn mane lies curled asleep on a small cushion, a round felt snore bubble floating above it, one eye just cracked open.
A small felt hedgehog tiptoes toward its paw and has frozen mid-step.
The mood is breath-held sneaking, a roar about to happen.
story-stones:
A tiny felt dragon in muted sage with small cream wings sits on a smooth river stone, curious and friendly.
In front of it, three smooth flat stones lie in a row, each painted with one simple picture: a crown, a castle tower and a crescent moon.
The mood is a story about to begin.
i-spy-switch:
A small wooden magnifying glass with a glass-bead lens hovers over a cluster of handmade things: a terracotta felt apple, a round cream yarn ball, a clay spoon and a little lavender cube.
The lens is sliding from the apple toward the ball, the clue just switching.
The mood is sharp-eyed fun.
day-says-night:
A small wooden seesaw sits on the rug with an ochre felt sun on one end and a cream felt crescent moon on the other, caught mid-tip.
A tiny clay owl perches in the middle, head turned toward the moon. A few stitched stars hang above.
The mood is quick and cheeky, everything flipped.
whisper-telephone:
