Two small clay cups joined by a long soft yarn string make a toy telephone.
A plush lavender-grey elephant holds one cup to its big ear, and a tiny felt mouse whispers into the other.
Faint pencil curls travel along the string between them.
The mood is hushed and secret.
sofa-arm-missing:
A plump cream fabric sofa cushion. On top of it stand three small handmade toys in a row, a felt rabbit, a wooden block and a clay ball, with a clear empty gap where a fourth toy stood.
The wheel of a tiny wooden toy car peeks out from under the cushion.
The mood is a playful riddle: who is missing?
sofa-shopping:
A small wooden toy train pulls three open wagons in a line: the first carries a clay spoon, the second a rolled cream wool sock, the third a tiny dusty-blue cloth book.
An empty fourth wagon is just being hooked on at the back.
The mood is a proud mission, all fetched in one trip.
countdown-stop:
A curving row of ten smooth clay pebbles in cream, sage and ochre.
A small felt penguin hops along them from the far end and has stopped dead, beak pressed shut, one flipper lifted above the fourth pebble from the end, which glows warm ochre.
The mood is a hushed, giggly stop.
belly-boat:
A small hand-stitched felt sailboat with a cream sail rides on top of a single rounded knitted wave in powder blue, a gentle swell like a breathing belly.
A few tiny pencil-drawn arcs above the boat show it slowly rising and sinking.
The mood is quiet and drowsy, slow breathing before sleep.
yes-means-no:
A cream wool sock sits in the middle of the rug.
Beside it, a small knitted frog with a cheeky grin holds up a round felt sign stitched with a cross, while a matching sign stitched with a tick lies face down.
Tiny pencil giggle marks pop around its head.
The mood is cheeky and upside down.
tell-it-back:
A small closed sage cloth book sits at one end of the rug.
From it, a little path of four felt picture tiles winds away: a stitched house, a tree, a bridge and a moon, one step of the story each.
A felt fox stands at the last tile, looking back along the path.
The mood is calm, remembering in order.
rhyme-chain:
A chain of soft knitted links in sage and ochre loops across the rug.
On each link sits a tiny thing that rhymes: a felt cat, a little knitted hat, a felt bat and a woven mat.
The last link is open and empty, waiting for the next.
The mood is playful and bouncy.
moon-suitcase:
A papier-mâché rocket made from a rolled lavender cushion points toward a cream felt moon on a thin wire.
Beside it, an open brown felt suitcase is packed in a neat row: a toothbrush, a tiny knitted hat and a clay cup.
A little torch lies forgotten outside the case.
The mood is a big pretend trip.
clap-or-tap:
A small felt drum and a pair of tiny clay cymbals sit side by side.
Between them goes a little parade: a felt zebra heading for the cymbals, a terracotta colour swatch heading for the drum, and a clay spoon stopped halfway, going nowhere.
The mood is quick sorting with a giggle.
frozen-face:
A round mirror with a carved wooden handle stands propped on the rug.
A plush ochre knitted monkey faces it, cheeks puffed and tongue out, frozen stiff, its silly face shown in the glass.
Five stitched dots curve below it, four filled in, counting the hold.
The mood is holding in a giggle.
which-hand-wait:
Two small knitted mittens, one sage and one terracotta, lie closed side by side.
The tip of a rolled cream sock peeks from the cuff of the sage one. A short line of pencil music notes floats above them.
A felt hedgehog sits in front, perfectly still, waiting for the song to end.
The mood is patient, bursting to choose.
five-sounds:
Around the rug's edge sit five tiny handmade things that make sounds: a felt songbird on a twig, a little clay clock, a clay tap with one bead of water falling, a sleeping knitted cat, and a paper leaf caught in a breeze.
Faint pencil-drawn sound ripples drift from each one. The middle of the rug is empty and still.
The mood is stillness and careful listening.
three-kind-things:
Three small felt hearts in terracotta, ochre and lavender sit in a row, each beside a tiny gift: a paper flower, a shared biscuit and a mended toy car.
A fourth sage heart, only half stitched, waits at the end for tomorrow.
The mood is soft and warm, a gentle landing at the end of the day.
melting-snowman:
A small cream felt snowman with a twig arm and a terracotta felt scarf is melting from the bottom up, its base already a soft wool puddle spreading over the rug.
A warm ochre felt sun glows gently above it.
The mood is slow and sleepy, everything going soft.
spot-my-change:
A lavender knitted bunny sits wearing one striped sock, with a small sage cushion balanced on its head.
The other sock lies beside it, just pulled off, and a pencil loop circles the bare paw.
The mood is a sharp-eyed little mystery.
rewind-the-day:
A small clay clock with no numbers sits at one end, a pencil arrow curling backwards around it.
From it, a little trail runs back across the rug: a bath duck, a muddy felt boot, a lunch bowl and, at the far end, an egg cup with a felt egg.
The mood is drowsy remembering.
zoo-list:
A long string of cream bunting stretches across the rug, each little felt flag stitched with a simple animal shape: a striped zebra, a giraffe, an elephant and a lion.
The last flag on the string is blank, waiting for the next animal.
The mood is a list that keeps on growing.
three-clues:
Three small felt cards lie in a row: one a plain grey square, one stitched with a big round shape, one with a curling trunk.
At the end of the row, a lumpy grey shape waits under a cream cloth, just the tip of a trunk peeking out.
The mood is bursting to guess, but holding it in.
ear-hands:
A small cloth picture book stands open with stitched pictures of a boat and a moon.
A little felt fox sits behind it reading aloud, faint pencil curls drifting from the page.
Opposite, a plush lavender elephant listens with its big ears fanned wide, completely silent.
The mood is quiet and attentive.
torch-trail:
A small wooden torch lies on the rug, its soft warm beam resting on a clay teacup.
A knitted ball and a felt boot sit nearby in the dim, each with a row of stitched dots beside it showing the order they were lit.
The mood is hushed and dim, remembering in order.
towel-surprise:
A soft sage towel is wrapped into a lumpy bundle, a felt toy ear peeking out at one corner.
Beside it, a small knitted penguin sits with its flippers over its eyes, waiting.
A curve of stitched dots on the rug fills in slowly as the count goes on.
The mood is patient, tingling anticipation.
spoon-bell:
A terracotta clay cup sits upside down over a single biscuit, its edge just showing.
A small wooden spoon hovers above the cup, tilted, about to tap it like a bell, a faint pencil ring of sound ready.
A small clay turtle waits beside it, perfectly still.
The mood is the tense wait before the ding.
sofa-doctor:
A small honey felt teddy lies on a tiny sage cushion under a knitted blanket, a felt hiccup bubble floating above it.
Beside it sits a little doctor's kit laid out in a neat row of three: a toy stethoscope, a wooden thermometer and a felt bandage.
The mood is silly and caring.
wrong-word:
A cloth picture book lies open on the rug. On its page, a stitched cat wears a small paper boat as a hat, which is plainly wrong.
A small clay owl stands at the edge of the page, one wing raised to call stop.
The mood is the delight of catching a mistake.
eyes-shut-claps:
A small lavender cushion stands upright like a screen, and behind it three faint pencil clap bursts puff into the air.
In front, a knitted lamb sits with its eyes stitched shut, three cream pebbles laid neatly before it.
The mood is quiet, careful counting.
missing-word-song:
Felt music notes drift across the rug in a gentle wavy line.
In the middle of the line, where one note should be, hangs a small ochre felt star with a little burst of pencil clap marks around it.
A small knitted songbird sits at the start of the line, beak open.
The mood is quiet singing with a playful pause.
what-next-coach:
A wobbly tower of wooden blocks in sage, ochre and cream stands taller than a terracotta clay cup beside it, and a flat block bridges from the cup to the tower.
A tiny felt teddy is halfway across the bridge. A folded knitted blanket lies to the side, still.
The mood is curious building.
squeeze-code:
Two small felt mittens rest cuff to cuff, linked by a soft yarn loop.
Above them float two short pencil pulses, a secret squeeze.
Beside them, a little knitted frog has just stuck out its tongue, following the code.
The mood is secret and giggly in the dark.
pretend-phone:
An old-fashioned clay toy telephone in terracotta sits ringing, faint pencil lines shaking around it.
Its receiver has been lifted by a small knitted grey wolf wrapped in a lavender grandma shawl, mouth open mid-voice.
The mood is silly voices and surprise callers.
sofa-captain:
A dotted pencil route winds across the rug: two stitched steps, a turn, then under a small arch made from a folded sage cushion.
A wooden toy car waits at the end of the route.
A small clay turtle in a paper captain's hat is halfway along, about to crawl under the arch.
The mood is following orders on an adventure.
tree-and-rock:
A small felt tree with a sage crown stands balanced on one thin trunk, gently wobbling.
Beside it, a smooth round grey clay rock sits small and still.
Five stitched dots curve between them like slow breaths.
The mood is calm and steady.
plan-then-play:
Three little scenes sit in a row like a plan: a tiny felt raccoon stirring a clay pot, two wooden toy cars nose to nose mid-bump, and a little tin bath with felt bubbles, still empty.
A dotted pencil line links them in order.
The mood is a plan coming to life.
statue-hide:
A soft cream knitted blanket is draped into a lumpy hill on the rug, the striped tail of a knitted ginger cat poking out one side, perfectly still.
A faint pencil swirl of a wrong guess drifts over the other side.
The mood is frozen, giggly hiding.
say-then-do:
A small knitted lamb sits wearing one striped sock.
A second sock and a sage scarf are laid out beside it in order, and a small empty felt speech bubble floats above, the next step said before it happens.
The mood is slow and thoughtful.
true-ball:
A soft ochre knitted ball rolls toward a small felt puppy who sits ready, paws open to catch it.
A second lavender ball, stitched with a tiny cow with wings, rolls straight past, ignored.
The mood is silly, quick judging.
hum-that-tune:
A plump felt bumblebee in ochre and cream hovers over the rug, humming, a wavy line of pencil music notes trailing behind it.
Below, a small clay snail has paused with its head tilted, listening hard for the tune.
The mood is soft and late-evening.
finger-fibber:
A small lavender knitted octopus holds up three of its arms high, the rest curled under it.
A felt speech bubble floats beside it stitched with five dots, a cheeky fib.
The mood is playful trickery.
invisible-box:
A small open papier-mâché box in cream sits on the rug, lid tipped back, and it looks empty.
Rising out of it, drawn only in a faint pencil outline, floats an ice cream cone, as if pulled from thin air.
A pencil teacup outline waits its turn inside.
The mood is make-believe magic.
turn-tower:
A half-built tower of wooden blocks in sage, ochre and cream, one block hovering just above the top, placed slowly.
A second block waits on the rug beside a small knitted bunny that sits still with its paws tucked in, waiting its turn.
The mood is patient and unhurried.
one-word-each:
Two small felt songbirds, one sage and one terracotta, perch facing each other on a twig.
Single pencil music notes drift between them, one note at a time, taking turns.
The mood is gentle and back-and-forth.
dragon-clap:
A small sage felt dragon with ochre felt spikes curls on the rug, a burst of pencil clap lines popping just above it.
Nearby sit the tricksters, a felt dragonfly and a little wooden wagon.
A small clay cake waits at the edge for later.
The mood is story-time with a trap.
back-drawing:
A small clay turtle lies on the rug, and a soft glowing circle is being traced slowly on its shell.
Beside it, a faint pencil zigzag waits to be drawn next.
The mood is sleepy and soothing.
answer-drum:
Two little felt-topped drums sit facing each other.
Above the left one hang three short pencil beats in a row, above the right one a different answer: one long beat and two quick ones.
A pair of wooden drumsticks rests on the right drum, mid-answer.
The mood is a lively conversation without words.
rusty-robot:
A small tin-and-clay robot with rusty terracotta patches stands stiff on the rug, one arm raised.
A tiny bolt and a spring have popped loose beside it, and pencil buzz lines crackle around its head, as if it just broke down.
The mood is bossy and silly.
guess-my-rule:
Socks are sorted into two neat piles: striped sage and cream socks on one side, plain ochre socks on the other.
One striped sock hangs mid-air between them, about to land.
A small felt raccoon peers at the piles through a tiny magnifying glass.
The mood is detective work.
gap-clap:
A long line of felt dots runs across the rug, alternating ochre and lavender, never two the same in a row, like claps landing in the gaps.
A little clay clock sits at the start, ticking steadily.
The mood is steady rhythm and quiet focus.
hands-in-lap:
Three toys sit in a row on a small sage cloth: a terracotta wooden car, a cream knitted ball and a little felt boat.
A plush koala sits before them, paws folded, choosing with words, an empty felt speech bubble above its head.
The mood is polite and patient.
eyes-shut-map:
Around the edge of the rug stand a toy-sized felt lamp with a warm glow, a little wooden door and a felt window frame, like a tiny model room.
In the middle, a felt squirrel with eyes stitched shut points one paw straight at the lamp.
The mood is confident blind-guessing.
teddy-password:
A small felt teddy guard in an ochre knitted hat sits on top of a soft mound of blanket, one paw raised, asking for the password.
On the rug below rests a tiny purple felt elephant charm on a string, the secret.
The mood is a sleepy little secret kept.
animal-twins:
A row of little felt cards lies across the rug, each stitched with an animal: a cow, a duck, a duck again, then a pig.
The two duck cards side by side glow warmly, a pencil spark popping between them.
The mood is a quiet catch in the dark.
toe-names:
Five tiny clay foods sit in a row: a pizza slice, a banana, a bowl of soup, a cheese wedge and an egg.
The banana is wiggling, pencil wiggle lines around it. A small knitted sock lies at the start of the row.
The mood is silly bedtime remembering.
describe-no-name:
A small toy hides under a lavender felt cloth, just its round wooden wheels showing.
Around it float faint pencil sketches of clues: a wheel, a little horn and a pair of round lamps.
The mood is careful words, no giveaways.
colour-not-name:
Small handmade things are scattered around the rug: a blue clay cup, a terracotta felt apple, a sage knitted leaf and an ochre wooden duck.
Beside each hangs a felt colour swatch of the same shade, as if the colours had stepped out of their objects.
The mood is quick and bright.
just-a-picture:
A small plush giraffe sits on a lavender cushion, framed by a carved wooden picture frame standing upright in front of it, like a painting in a museum.
A tiny felt rope barrier on two posts keeps a polite distance.
The mood is calm admiring before the toy turns real.
sneeze-number:
A curving row of ten smooth clay pebbles in cream and sage.
The fourth pebble wears a tiny knitted scarf, and a felt puff of sneeze bursts from it. A small felt tissue lies beside it.
The mood is giggly counting.
odd-one-twice:
Three things sit in a row: a red felt apple, a yellow felt banana and a small red wooden car.
A pencil circle loops around the car, and a second dotted circle loops around the banana, two right answers at once.
The mood is clever puzzling.
twist-button:
A knitted grey wolf, shrunk to the size of a pea, stands beside a tiny green felt pea just as big.
A big round terracotta felt button sits nearby, just pressed, a pencil spark bursting from it.
The mood is surprise twists in a story.
tuck-in-swap:
A big plush hedgehog lies tucked under a small sage blanket.
A little knitted bunny half its size sits at the edge, holding a tiny cloth book open, reading to it like a grown-up.
The mood is cosy role-swapping.
word-station:
A small wooden toy train stops at a little felt platform, a pear, a plum and a banana riding in its open wagon.
On the track ahead, a second platform holds a felt cow and a felt pig, the next station.
The mood is calm, quiet travelling.
sound-detective:
A terracotta clay cup, a small sage cloth book and a little wooden duck sit in a row.
The cup has just been tapped, and faint pencil sound ripples spread from it.
A felt mouse in a tiny detective cap listens nearby, eyes stitched shut.
The mood is a quiet mystery.
tune-switch:
A ribbon of pencil music notes drifts across the rug, starting as little felt stars and, halfway along, turning into felt leaves.
At the switch point a small clay owl raises one wing.
The mood is soft humming and a sharp ear.
ceiling-cinema:
A tiny ochre felt dragon flies above the rug along a curving dotted pencil path, from a small glowing felt lamp toward the far edge.
A soft sage cushion lies flat on the rug, a place to lie and watch.
The mood is dreamy, make-believe flight.
silent-ten:
A soft cream knitted blanket lies smooth over most of the rug, small mounds beneath it shifting as if counting.
A row of stitched dots along its hem fills in one by one, and at the end a single pencil clap burst pops in the air.
The mood is silent and still.
swap-story:
A small cloth storybook lies open, and its story runs off the page as one long yarn ribbon.
A felt fox holds the ribbon at one end and has just passed it, mid-sentence, to a knitted frog, a tiny pencil spark marking the swap.
The mood is playful, interrupted storytelling.
sock-hunt:
Five rolled cream and ochre wool sock balls are hidden around the rug: one peeks from behind a small sage felt cushion, one from under a folded knitted blanket corner.
Three found ones sit in a tiny wicker basket, and a felt hedgehog noses toward the cushion, where a soft warm glow says it is getting warmer.
The mood is a warm, giggly hunt.
mirror:
Two matching knitted bunnies, one sage and one lavender, face each other across the middle of the rug like reflections.
Both hold the exact same pose, one paw raised high and heads tipped the same way, frozen in slow motion.
The mood is quiet concentration and a held-back giggle.
pillow-island:
Small felt cushions in ochre, sage and cream are scattered like islands on a sea of tiny blue-grey glass beads.
A knitted frog is caught mid-leap between two islands, and a bare patch of beads shows where one island was just taken away.
The mood is daring and bouncy: don't touch the water!
simon-says:
A clay owl in a tiny felt crown stands on a pebble like a little leader, one wing raised to give an order.
Before it, a felt fox has frozen halfway through a move, paw lifted toward its nose, caught out.
The mood is cheeky and alert, the moment of being caught.
bear-dragon:
Two sock puppets stand upright on the rug: a cream sock bear with round felt ears and a soft smile, and a sage sock dragon with ochre felt spikes, mouth open in a grumpy growl.
A small knitted lamb sits between them, turned firmly toward the bear.
The mood is silly and gently defiant.
heads-mean-toes:
A knitted monkey is folded right over, paws reaching down to the rug, while a tiny felt hat tumbles off the top of its head.
Beside it, two small felt arrows cross, one pointing up and one pointing down, swapped.
The mood is giggly confusion, getting it right the wrong way.
purple-light:
A small wooden signal post holds two felt discs: the lavender one glows softly and the terracotta one is dark.
A wooden pull-along duck on a cream felt path has just stopped, frozen mid-roll, one wheel still lifted.
The mood is tiptoe suspense, waiting for the switch.
sock-colour-freeze:
A fan of odd socks in sage, ochre, lavender and terracotta lies on the rug, with one terracotta sock lifted high on a little wooden peg.
Felt music notes hang still in the air, and a plush elephant has frozen with its trunk on a terracotta clay pot.
The mood is a breathless, happy freeze.
cup-drum-walk:
A terracotta clay cup sits upside down with a small wooden spoon resting on top, and pencil-drawn beat marks pulse out from it.
A felt penguin marches along a dotted trail of tiny stitched steps, caught mid-stride, one side lifted.
The mood is rhythmic and bouncy, step on the beat.
clap-conductor:
A felt mouse stands on a pebble podium, holding a thin twig baton high above its head.
In front of it, felt music notes rise in a row, big notes up high and tiny ones low, with a quiet gap where the music stops.
The mood is grand and playful, loud then hush.
clap-echo:
Two small wooden castanets, one sage and one ochre, face each other across the rug.
Above the sage one floats a short row of stitched dots, some close together and some apart, and above the ochre one the same row repeats, as if answering.
The mood is a playful call and reply.
sock-sort-switch:
Two felt cushions sit side by side, a dusky lavender one holding dark socks and a cream one holding light socks, with a jumble of socks in the middle.
A felt hedgehog stands at the pile, and one sock hangs mid-air above a curved pencil arrow swinging between the cushions.
The mood is busy and tidy, with a sudden twist.
cup-shuffle:
Three soft terracotta clay cups sit upside down in a row, two of them sliding past each other along curved pencil arrows.
A knitted raccoon sits in front, eyes wide, following the moving cups, and a tiny cream sock tail pokes out from under one rim.
The mood is sharp-eyed suspense: which cup?
build-my-plan:
A small paper card shows a pencil sketch of stacked shapes: three cups, a book, then two cups.
Beside it rises the real tower: three sage clay cups, a little cloth book laid flat on top, one ochre cup set on it and the last cup hovering just above.
The mood is careful and proud, building from memory.
five-breath-zoo:
A wooden giraffe stretches as tall as it can beside a knitted frog crouched low, both holding perfectly still.
In front of them, five small felt pebbles lie in a row, the first two glowing softly, one breath each.
The mood is calm and wobble-free.
pretend-restaurant:
A felt cushion serves as a table, set with three small dishes in a neat row: a clay bowl of ochre felt soup, a felt pizza slice and a felt banana, plus a little clay cup.
A felt fox waiter stands beside it holding a tiny wooden tray.
The mood is proud and fussy, service with a flourish.
opposite-day-preschool:
A felt hare sits perfectly still with puffs of dust behind it, as if it just braked hard, while a tiny clay snail beside it zooms forward with pencil speed lines.
A small felt megaphone lies upside down next to a soft felt hush cloud.
The mood is topsy-turvy and silly.
sculptor-statue:
A knitted bunny stands on a small wooden plinth, frozen in a ridiculous pose, one arm stretched up and one leg kicked out.
Beside the plinth lie a tiny wooden sculpting tool and a lump of soft matte clay.
The mood is giggly stillness, trying very hard not to move.
less-is-more:
Two piles of rolled sock balls sit on the rug: a small pile of two and a big pile of five.
A wooden pointer arrow lies aimed at the little pile, while a clay pig snuggles happily against the big pile.
The mood is clever and cheeky, winning by pointing the other way.
closed-hands:
A knitted owl sits with its eyes squeezed shut and its wings folded tight, waiting.
Around it, a ring of stitched dots is almost all filled in, and a tiny wooden spinning top hovers just above, about to land.
The mood is patient, fidgety waiting with a treat at the end.
book-detective:
A cloth picture book lies open, its pages showing felt pictures: a red ball, a red boot, a round yellow sun and a green leaf.
A small wooden magnifying glass rests over the red ball, the one that is both red and round.
The mood is sharp-eyed and proud: found it!
slow-tightrope:
A long thin sage scarf lies straight across the rug like a tightrope.
Halfway along, a clay turtle inches forward very slowly, a cream sock ball balanced on top of its shell.
The mood is wobbly concentration, slow and steady.
whisper-orders:
A felt squirrel leans in close to a curled cream seashell, as if whispering into it, and tiny pencil dots drift softly out.
Nearby, a knitted lamb sleeps under a little felt blanket, undisturbed.
The mood is hushed and secretive.
floor-map:
Ochre felt cushions rise like little mountains, a lavender scarf winds across the rug as a river, and a small papier-mâché castle stands at the far edge.
A dotted pencil route links river, mountains and castle, and a wooden toy train waits at the start.
The mood is a big adventure about to begin.
three-moves:
Three small felt stepping pads lie in a row, each stitched with a simple symbol: a spring coil, a starburst and a curly arrow.
A knitted monkey is caught mid-jump above the first pad, with pencil arcs showing its bounce.
The mood is lively and focused, one move after another.
turtle-rabbit:
A cream paper sheet lies on the rug with an ochre crayon line across it: tight slow wiggles, then a long fast swoosh, then slow again.
A small clay turtle sits at one end of the line and a felt rabbit at the other, and a fat wax crayon rests mid-page.
The mood is playful, slow then zoom.
my-rule-your-rule:
A pair of small wooden clappers has just snapped shut, a little pencil spark between them.
Beside them, a felt kangaroo is caught mid-hop above the rug, right on cue.
The mood is bossy fun, rules made and followed.
sock-money-shop:
Three small toys stand in a row on felt stands: a clay boat, a felt star and a wooden car, each stand stitched with one, two or three dots for its price.
A little pile of rolled sock coins sits nearby, one coin halfway to the shop.
The mood is busy, careful shopkeeping.
sun-moon-switch:
A small clay lamp glows warm and golden, and beside it a knitted cat has curled up tight as if for the night.
Above them, a felt sun and a felt moon hang from a bent twig, swinging gently.
The mood is cosy and playful, a flick away from waking.
lips-and-ears:
A felt picture book lies open in the middle of the rug.
On one side rests a small wooden spoon and on the other a soft sage clay cup, with a curved pencil arc between them showing they are about to swap.
The mood is calm turn-taking, one talks and one listens.
ready-steady-wait:
A terracotta clay cup stands upright a little way off.
Three cream sock balls wait in a line, and a felt badger crouches behind them, poised and still, the first ball just trembling.
The mood is coiled, eager waiting for go.
under-the-cloth:
A sage gingham tea towel is draped over five lumpy shapes on the rug.
One corner is lifted, revealing a wooden duck and a felt star underneath, the other shapes still hidden.
The mood is the thrill of checking: did I remember?
say-not-do:
A felt bear touches one paw to its ear, while a faint pencil arrow curls from that paw toward its nose.
Beside it, a knitted chick touches its own nose, ignoring the bear's trick.
The mood is sly and giggly, not falling for it.
program-the-robot:
A small papier-mâché toy robot stands on a grid of cream felt squares, facing a clay cup at the far corner.
Three felt arrow cards lie in a row beside it: forward, forward, turn, and the robot has just bumped gently into a wooden block.
The mood is careful, step-by-step planning.
silent-zoo:
A small felt dragon holds a tiny wooden toothbrush, mouth shut tight and eyes squeezed in a big comic grin.
Not a single sound line drifts from it, and a soft felt hush cloud floats above.
The mood is bursting, silent silliness.
pattern-tower:
A tower of square blocks rises from the rug in a neat pattern: terracotta, lavender, terracotta, lavender.
The next terracotta block hovers just above the top, about to be placed, and a few loose blocks wait nearby.
The mood is careful and satisfying, keeping the pattern going.
magic-word:
A cloth storybook lies open with soft felt pictures, a little felt bear on one page.
A knitted otter springs straight up above the book, mid-jump, pencil lines showing it just leapt from sitting.
The mood is bouncy, ears-open listening.
stop-the-song:
A small wooden music box sits open, and a row of felt music notes streams out of it.
The row stops suddenly mid-air, the last note frozen, and a felt songbird beside the box holds its beak open, stopped mid-note.
The mood is a giggly, sudden hush.
ten-second-ears:
A felt fox sits perfectly still on a short path of small pebbles, ears pricked high.
Around it, faint pencil sound ripples drift from three tiny things: a felt bird on a twig, a little clay bell and a paper leaf.
The mood is quiet, careful listening.
topsy-turvy-sort:
A big cream cushion holds only tiny toys: a thimble-sized wooden duck, a felt star and a clay marble.
A small sage cushion beside it is squashed under a big plush elephant that barely fits.
The mood is topsy-turvy and funny.
no-repeats-roll:
A soft felt ball rolls along a pencil trail between a knitted mole and a felt seal, sitting facing each other.
Around them lie little felt animal shapes already named: a fish, a bird, a snail.
The mood is quick, friendly back-and-forth.
slow-motion-replay:
Two felt cushions stand apart as a goal, and a cream sock ball floats in mid-air toward it, with faint ghost copies trailing slowly behind.
A felt penguin celebrates in slow motion, flippers raised high, frozen mid-cheer.
The mood is goal-scoring joy, played very slowly.
teach-your-teddy:
A plush teddy sits watching a stack of five clay cups being built in sage, ochre and cream.
Three cups are stacked, the fourth hovers just above, and the fifth waits on the rug.
The mood is patient and proud, teaching step by step.
fill-the-gap:
A row of felt music notes drifts across the rug with one gap in the middle where a note is missing.
A felt robin perches beside the gap, beak open, ready to sing it in, while a sleepy felt crescent moon rests at the edge.
The mood is cosy, bedtime singing.
tap-the-cups:
Four clay cups stand in a row in sage, ochre, lavender and terracotta.
A small wooden spoon rests against the second cup, and a dotted pencil arc hops from the first cup to the third, showing the order of the taps.
The mood is focused, remembering the tune.
step-step-clap:
A felt goose waddles along a cream felt strip, caught mid-step.
Behind it runs a trail: two stitched webbed prints, a small pencil starburst, two webbed prints, a starburst.
The mood is marching rhythm, steady and bouncy.
animal-or-food:
Two little groups sit on the rug: handmade animal toys, a felt fish and a clay pig, and felt food, a clay carrot and a felt loaf.
Right between them sits a brown clay chocolate bunny, belonging to both sides.
The mood is quick and tricky, which one is it?
pass-the-pose:
Two felt otters stand facing each other in nearly the same pose, tails curled the same way.
The only difference: one has a flipper raised high, and a faint pencil sparkle marks the change.
The mood is silly and attentive, spot the difference.
banana-means-yes:
A felt banana and a clay apple sit side by side on the rug next to a little wooden toy car.
A felt parrot perches between them with its beak pressed tightly shut, holding back the real word.
The mood is cheeky, trying not to slip.
peek-and-build:
A felt cushion stands upright like a screen, one corner lifted to show a three-block tower hiding behind it.
In front of the cushion, a matching tower is half built, its third block hovering in place.
The mood is a quick peek and a careful remember.
what-else-is-it:
A knitted frog wears a terracotta clay cup upside down on its head like a hat.
Faint pencil ghosts around it show the same cup as a little boat and a telephone.
The mood is playful, endless imagination.
one-more-hop:
Five odd socks lie in a line, each stitched with one to five small dots.
A felt kangaroo is mid-hop over the sock with two dots, heading for the one with three, a pencil arc tracing its jump.
The mood is bouncy and thinking-fast.
grandma-footsteps:
A plush owl sits with its back turned at one end of the rug.
Behind it, a felt mouse has frozen mid-creep, one paw raised, faint dotted steps behind it.
The mood is breathless, tiptoe suspense.
empty-cups:
Five clay cups sit upside down in a row. One is lifted to show nothing underneath, and another tips up to reveal a cream sock ball.
Two found sock balls rest beside the row.
The mood is careful remembering, where were they?
which-toy:
Six small toys stand on the rug: a wooden boat, a felt star, a clay ball, a knitted dog, a felt fish and a paper crown.
Three have been pushed to the edge, and a soft warm glow rings the remaining three.
The mood is clever, narrowing it down.
stop-at-seven:
Seven stitched dots curve in an arc across the rug, the seventh glowing softly.
A knitted lamb has just landed exactly on the last dot, frozen still, with pencil bounce arcs behind it.
The mood is bouncy, then a perfect stop.
just-enough-roll:
A sage felt cushion sits on the rug, and a soft ochre ball has rolled to just touch it.
Two faint dotted trails show earlier tries, one stopping short and one rolling past.
The mood is gentle aim and pride: just right.
car-clap:
A strip of grey felt road holds little wooden toy cars: two terracotta red, one cream, and a small ochre felt bus at the end.
A pair of tiny wooden clappers hovers above a red car, a pencil spark between them.
The mood is lively, a game on the go.
oops-plan:
A knitted badger stands at a tiny felt shop stall, its little basket empty and the shelf bare.
Nearby wait a small clay pan and a bunting garland for a party, and a soft pencil swirl shows the oops.
The mood is bouncy problem-solving: the party goes on.
secret-sorter:
Two felt cushions sit side by side: soft toys on the left, a knitted ball and a felt star, and hard toys on the right, a wooden block and a clay car.
A small felt sheep hovers midway between them, about to be placed.
The mood is curious, cracking the code.
three-zones:
Three small felt mats lie in a triangle on the rug: one with a curled seashell, one with a tiny spring coil and one with felt music notes.
A felt hedgehog stands on the spring mat, mid-hop.
The mood is lively and quick-thinking.
changing-ball:
A ball floats mid-air between a knitted raccoon and a felt bear, half grey clay like a rock and half soft white feather.
A little curl of felt steam rises from one side, as if it just turned hot.
The mood is imaginative and silly.
toy-homes:
Four toys head home: a wooden car under a small cardboard arch, a felt boat in a clay bowl and a knitted giraffe on a cushion.
A clay rabbit is caught mid-walk toward its little felt hut.
The mood is cheerful, everything in its place.
colour-hop:
Four socks lie in a line, terracotta, sage, ochre and lavender, with gaps between them.
A felt grasshopper hops along a dotted pencil path from terracotta to sage and back to terracotta, caught mid-air.
The mood is bouncy and colourful.
teddy-tempter:
Five clay cups are being stacked: four stand in a tower and the fifth hovers above.
Beside them, a plush teddy in a silly felt hat waves a long feather, trying to catch attention.
The mood is playful focus with a tempting distraction.
eyes-on-me-preschool:
A knitted bunny gazes straight up and forward, eyes fixed, not glancing down.
Low beside it, a wooden toy sailboat waits on a felt tuft, and ten stitched dots curve in an arc, half filled.
The mood is patient waiting, nearly there.
flamingo-pass:
Two felt flamingos in soft terracotta stand on one leg each, facing each other.
A soft ball floats mid-air between them along a gentle pencil arc.
The mood is wobbly and joyful, balance and catch.
call-the-stop:
A soft ball has just come to rest at the end of a fading dotted trail.
A felt seal watches with one flipper raised, calling it at exactly the right moment.
The mood is calm, sharp-eyed timing.
find-the-song-preschool:
A small wooden music box half hides under a corner of a knitted blanket, soft felt notes drifting out.
A felt koala creeps toward it, ears cocked, following the music.
The mood is quiet and curious, getting warmer.
stop-and-name:
A dotted pencil path loops around the rug past three small things: a clay pot, a felt ball and a little wooden lamp.
A clay snail has stopped at the end of the path, still and thinking.
The mood is calm and focused, remembering the way.
freeze-dance:
A small felt fox in rust and cream stands frozen mid-dance on one back leg, both paws flung up and tail swung wide.
Beside it a little wooden music box sits open, and a few felt music notes hang still in the air above it, stopped mid-float.
The mood is giggly stillness: the instant the music stops.
animal-race:
A narrow strip of cream felt runs across the rug like a tiny race track.
A terracotta felt crab scuttles sideways along it, caught mid-stride, while a knitted sage frog crouches at the start, ready to leap after it.
A little paper flag on a stick marks the far end.
The mood is a noisy, happy race.
obstacle:
A tiny obstacle course winds across the rug: a small wooden chair, a plump ochre felt cushion and a round clay table.
A felt hedgehog is halfway under the chair, crawling low, and a dotted pencil trail shows the route still ahead.
Three small stitched dots beside the course keep the slow count.
The mood is busy and proud.
three-lights:
A little wooden post holds three round felt lights: terracotta, sage and lavender. The lavender one glows softly.
In front of it a knitted cream bunny is caught on tiptoe, stepping in slow, exaggerated sneaks, one paw lifted high.
The mood is giggly concentration on the new rule.
sleeping-animals:
A plush grey elephant lies curled up asleep on the rug, eyes stitched shut, under a small felt crescent moon.
Next to it a little felt mouse has just popped awake, stretched up tall, mid-wiggle, as if turning into something new.
The mood is a hush about to burst into play.
backwards-dance:
A small wooden metronome swings fast, with quick pencil motion lines around its arm.
Beside it a clay turtle dances in exaggerated slow motion, one leg lifted high, faint ghost outlines trailing behind to show how slowly it moves.
The mood is silly topsy-turvy fun.
two-orders-go:
A felt penguin leans forward at one edge of the rug, waiting for the word to go.
A dotted pencil path leads first to a tiny wooden toy door, then curves on to a little knitted toy sofa, with one stitched dot by the door and two by the sofa.
The mood is careful listening before the dash.
wiggle-and-stop:
A knitted lavender octopus holds perfectly still, one curly arm still raised from its wiggle, the rest tucked tight.
Faint pencil wiggle lines hang frozen around that one arm.
A row of stitched dots across the rug grows longer, each stop held one count more than the last.
The mood is a wobbly held breath.
memory-relay:
A felt squirrel in warm ochre dashes across the rug with its arms full: a small terracotta clay cup, a rolled cream wool sock and a tiny dusty-blue wooden car, all carried at once and nearly toppling.
A dotted trail runs back to where they came from.
The mood is a hurried, triumphant fetch.
clap-swap-leader:
Two toys march in a line across the rug: a wooden duck in front and a small felt badger right behind, copying the same high-lifted step.
Above them a little pencil-drawn burst shows a single clap, and the badger is just stepping out ahead to take the lead.
The mood is bouncy and bossy in turns.
clap-feet:
Two small brass-coloured felt cymbals rest apart, suddenly silent.
In front of them a knitted puppy is frozen mid-step, one paw lifted, and the pencil step marks behind it go from far apart to close together.
The mood is the surprise of a sudden stop.
sock-toss-count:
A sage clay cup stands near the rug's edge with three rolled wool socks tucked inside, and one more sails toward it in a high pencil-drawn arc.
A few missed socks lie scattered nearby.
Small felt pebbles in a neat row count the ones that landed.
The mood is cheerful aim and counting.
plan-then-hide:
A small linen curtain hangs from a little wooden frame, and a knitted lamb hides behind it, only its round woolly tail poking out at the bottom.
Across the rug a felt raccoon sits with both paws over its eyes, counting.
The mood is giggles held in, very still.
rescue-mission:
A tiny knitted kitten toy sits stranded on top of a tall stack of wooden blocks.
Below, a plush grey elephant in a little terracotta felt cape climbs over two small cushions toward it, trunk stretched up.
A dotted pencil line marks the planned route.
The mood is brave and determined.
widening-river:
Two small sage cushions lie apart with a ribbon of blue-grey glass beads running between them like a river.
A knitted green frog sails across mid-leap, legs stretched out behind, high above the water.
A faint pencil mark shows where the bank sat last time, a little closer.
The mood is a bold, splashless jump.
knees-mean-toes:
A plush ochre monkey is caught in a giggly tangle, bent double with one paw on top of its head and the other reaching down, unsure which way to go.
Felt music notes float around it, crossed and swapped.
The mood is a happy mix-up.
pillow-tower-wait:
A tall, wobbly tower of tiny cushions in cream, sage and lavender leans slightly to one side.
Right beside it a felt lion cub sits very still, paws tucked behind its back, quivering with the wait.
The mood is bursting patience just before the crash.
clap-parade:
A little wooden pull-along train winds around the rug, its four cars carrying four felt animal cutouts in order: an elephant, a frog, a snake and a bird.
A pencil-drawn clap burst floats above the second car, the one now in front.
The mood is a proud, marching parade.
sock-in-a-cup:
A felt penguin walks carefully across the rug, balancing a small upside-down clay cup on one flipper.
A rolled cream sock sits on top of the cup, wobbling, with faint pencil wobble lines around it.
The mood is slow, careful balance.
yes-means-run:
A tiny felt cow with little paper wings dangles on a thread above the rug, as if it were flying.
Below, a clay hedgehog is frozen mid-run, one foot lifted, looking up at the silly cow.
The mood is giggly surprise at a silly question.
full-body-mirror:
Two identical knitted cream cats stand facing each other, each lifting the opposite paw high, exactly mirrored.
A thin line of pale silvery felt runs between them like the surface of a mirror, and slow felt music notes drift above.
The mood is slow, soft and in step.
crocodile-river:
Small cushions are scattered across a river of blue-grey glass beads like stepping stones.
A green felt crocodile with soft felt teeth lurks between them, jaws half open, while a felt mouse balances on one cushion, mid-step, planning the next.
The mood is daring, careful crossing.
window-spy-run:
A small wooden toy spyglass lies tilted on the rug, pointing out past the edge.
A felt fox races toward a little terracotta felt apple, caught mid-sprint, one paw stretched out to touch it.
The mood is quick eyes and quick paws.
conductor-arms:
A clay owl stands tall, one wing raised high holding a thin wooden baton.
Above the baton big, bold felt music notes leap up, while tiny pale notes rest low near the rug.
The mood is grand and silly, loud then quiet.
cup-drum-third-beat:
A terracotta clay cup sits upside down with a small wooden spoon resting on it like a drumstick.
Three stitched dots beside it, the third one glowing warm.
A knitted mouse is frozen mid-dance, one leg in the air, exactly on the third beat.
The mood is tense, giggly timing.
rocket-launch:
A papier-mâché rocket in cream and terracotta stands on a felt launch pad, its felt flame not yet lit.
Beside it a felt koala crouches very low, ready to spring.
A row of stitched dots shrinks toward the rocket like a countdown.
The mood is held breath before blast off.
shape-freeze:
A knitted cat is frozen mid-run, stretched out wide in a star shape, wobbling a little.
Around it lie small felt shapes: a star, a round ball, a little tree and an arched bridge.
The mood is wobbly, proud stillness.
add-a-move:
A paper chain lies across the rug, each loop a different muted colour, the newest loop just being added at the end.
Beside it a felt kangaroo is caught mid-hop, pencil lines showing the jump, crouch and spin it just did.
The mood is a growing, giggly challenge.
clap-code:
Three small felt cards lie in a row, stitched with one dot, two dots and three dots.
A pencil-drawn double burst floats above the middle card.
Beside it a knitted frog crouches low, frozen in the crouch the code just asked for.
The mood is quick, clever listening.
light-spot-chase-preschool:
A little wooden torch lies on the rug, just switched off, and a faint ghost of a warm glowing circle fades on the rug ahead of it.
A felt raccoon stands frozen beside the fading spot, one paw pointing right at it.
The mood is dim, cosy and exciting.
sorting-sprint:
Two small cushions sit side by side, one terracotta and one sage, each with a little pile of toys on it.
A felt squirrel sprints between them carrying a tiny terracotta wooden car toward the terracotta cushion.
A small clay ball and a wooden block wait on the rug to be sorted.
The mood is busy, speedy sorting.
lap-then-find:
Four small round cushions sit in a ring on the rug, and a tiny wooden boat peeks out from under the edge of one.
A dotted pencil trail loops all the way round the outside of the ring and ends right at that cushion.
The mood is a remembered secret, found.
safe-spot-lava:
Flat terracotta felt lava with soft amber felt bubbles spreads over most of the rug.
In the middle sits one small knitted cream mat, and a clay pig stands squeezed onto it, perched on tiptoe, safely out of the lava.
The mood is silly, breathless safety.
tiptoe-tag:
A felt mouse tiptoes away across the rug, raised high on its toes, looking back over its shoulder.
Behind it a felt fox creeps after it, also on tiptoe, one paw reaching out.
Tiny pencil marks show only the tips of their steps.
The mood is quiet, sneaky chasing.
sprint-and-settle:
A dotted pencil loop circles the rug, showing laps just run, with a row of stitched dots counting them.
In the middle a plush brown bear lies flat on its back, resting, with small soft felt clouds of slow breath rising above it.
The mood is calm after the rush.
tree-pose-tag:
A felt flamingo stands still on one leg in the middle of the rug, wings raised high like the branches of a tree.
A felt puppy waits just beside it, not allowed to tag, with five stitched dots counting down.
The mood is wobbly safety and giggles.
musical-cushion:
One round sage cushion sits in the middle of the rug.
A knitted bunny and a wooden duck both dive for it at the same moment, mid-leap, from opposite sides.
A small open music box beside them has just stopped, its felt notes dropping.
The mood is a giggly race.
airplane-airports:
A small papier-mâché airplane in cream and lavender flies along a dotted pencil route above the rug.
The route links three tiny landing spots in order: a little felt sofa, a wooden toy door and a small knitted armchair.
The mood is a swooping, happy flight.
sack-of-potatoes:
A small burlap sack full of clay potatoes sits on a little wooden toy wagon.
A floppy knitted sloth is draped limp over the top of it, arms dangling down the side.
One clay potato has just rolled off, mid-tumble, as if a giggle broke the spell.
The mood is floppy, silly fun.
act-it-out:
A felt fox runs around a small round clay table, a dotted pencil line looping three times around it.
Beside them lies an open little paper storybook whose pages hold only soft pencil swirls.
The mood is a story coming to life.
bear-hunt-rewind:
A dotted path winds through tufts of felt long grass, past a brown felt mud puddle and into a papier-mâché cave.
A plush bear peeks out from the cave, and a curling pencil arrow loops the path back the way it came.
The mood is a thrilling, silly adventure.
cushion-blueprint:
A sheet of paper lies on the rug with a simple wax crayon drawing of a den made of cushion shapes.
Next to it stands the real small den of stacked cushions, built to match, with a clay owl peeking out of the doorway.
A stubby ochre crayon lies beside the paper.
The mood is proud building.
glued-to-the-floor:
A plush grey hippo scoots across the rug in a lopsided crawl, one side pressed flat down, held by a small dab of shiny felt glue.
A wobbly dotted trail behind it shows the strange way it has come.
The mood is silly, stuck-but-moving fun.
one-move-behind:
A felt penguin dances in front, both flippers flung up in a new move.
Right behind it a wooden duck copies the penguin's old move, a low crouch, shown by a faint ghost outline of the penguin's last pose.
Slow felt music notes drift between them.
The mood is a funny, careful echo.
dont-copy-me:
A clay starfish in ochre stretches out in a big wide star shape.
Facing it, a felt hedgehog has curled into a tight little ball, doing anything but the star.
The mood is giggly, stubborn not-copying.
ball-stopper:
A soft knitted ochre ball has just been stopped dead against the side of a plush grey seal that threw itself in the way.
Pencil motion lines trail behind the ball, showing how fast it was rolling.
The mood is a last-second save.
laser-limbo:
Two little wooden chairs stand a short way apart with a thin lavender scarf stretched between them like a laser beam.
A felt weasel slides underneath on its tummy, very low, the scarf just above its back.
The mood is sneaky spy silence.
giant-steps:
A wooden giraffe takes one huge stride along a dotted pencil line across the rug.
Behind it a row of tiny hop marks shows where it had to do little bunny hops instead.
The mood is playful asking and silly answers.
sleeping-snake:
A long sage knitted scarf lies curved across the rug like a snake, with two button eyes, sleeping still under a small felt moon.
A knitted bunny is frozen just beside it, caught mid-hop, waiting for the snake to slither again.
The mood is giggly, jumpy suspense.
safe-word-tag:
A felt wolf in grey is frozen mid-reach, stopped in its tracks.
In front of it lie three small felt bananas in a row, one of them already peeled open, spent.
The mood is a silly, saving shout.
sneeze-freeze:
A plush grey elephant tips back mid-sneeze, a little burst of cream felt puff flying from its trunk.
Beside it a felt pig is frozen mid-dance, one leg raised, while pencil stamps and claps fade unheeded around them.
The mood is a silly, sudden freeze.
stop-on-the-sock:
A cream wool sock lies stretched across the rug like a finish line.
A wooden toy train has stopped with its front just touching the sock, not a hair past, pencil speed lines trailing behind it.
The mood is the thrill of a perfect stop.
towel-dance:
A small folded striped towel in cream and terracotta lies on the rug.
A felt hedgehog dances wildly on top of it, both paws in the air, staying right on the edge of the towel.
The mood is wild fun inside a tiny space.
puppet-strings:
A wooden marionette horse hangs from strings tied to a little wooden cross bar floating above it.
One string is pulled taut, lifting a single front leg, while the rest of the horse hangs floppy and still.
The mood is playful and a bit silly.
wolf-time:
A felt wolf in grey sits facing away at one edge of the rug.
A knitted lamb tiptoes toward it along a row of stitched dots, frozen mid-step, counting each one.
The mood is creeping, giggly suspense before the chase.
singing-monster:
A fuzzy lavender felt monster with stubby arms is frozen mid-creep, arms up.
Across from it a small knitted songbird has just closed its beak, and one last felt music note drops to the rug.
The mood is giggly suspense in sudden silence.
sock-pair-run:
A striped wool sock is pinned up on a little wooden peg stand.
Around the rug lie four odd socks in different muted colours, and a dotted pencil line runs from the pinned sock to its matching twin among them.
The mood is a quick, clever hunt.
loud-hands-quiet-feet:
Two small brass-coloured felt cymbals clash above the rug with big pencil sound bursts.
Below them a knitted goose marches in soft felt slippers, leaving no sound marks at all.
The mood is loud and quiet at once.
treasure-map-dash:
A crumpled paper map with a simple wax crayon drawing lies on the rug, a small crayon star marking one spot.
Nearby, a felt parrot stands beside a small cushion, under which a tiny wooden toy boat peeks out.
The mood is treasure-hunt excitement.
cushion-sandwich:
A small sage cushion is squeezed between a plush brown bear and a knitted bunny, pressed together face to face.
The two waddle sideways across the rug, paws held behind their backs, the cushion just slipping.
The mood is wobbly teamwork.
who-moved-it:
Five small things sit in a row: a cushion, a clay ball, a wooden block, a felt cup and a toy boat.
The wooden block has slid out of line, and a faint dotted outline shows where it used to be.
The mood is careful looking and surprise.
parcel-delivery:
A brown paper parcel tied with string rides in the back of a little wooden toy truck.
A dotted pencil path behind the truck loops and zigzags with wrong turns.
At the end of the path, a small brass bell waits by a tiny felt toy door.
The mood is giggly mischief.
clap-then-catch:
A gauzy lavender scarf floats slowly down through the air above the rug.
Below it a felt monkey holds its paws together mid-clap, waiting for the scarf to fall.
The mood is calm, playful waiting.
rest-stop-chase:
Three small cushions sit spaced around the rug, and a felt deer rests on one of them.
A clay tortoise lumbers after it in slow motion, mouth open in a slow roar, faint ghost outlines trailing behind it.
The mood is slow, fair, silly chasing.
exactly-ten-steps:
A dotted line of evenly stitched marks runs from a tiny wooden toy door to a little knitted sofa.
A wooden duck waddles along it, landing exactly on the last mark, right in front of the sofa.
The mood is careful, counted steps.
moving-island:
A sea of blue-grey glass beads covers most of the rug with two small knitted islands.
One island is sinking into the beads, while a felt chipmunk leaps toward the other.
A lavender knitted octopus sea monster rises from the beads between them.
The mood is a happy, frantic chase.
change-of-plan:
A dotted pencil path runs toward a tiny wooden toy door, then turns sharply away toward a little knitted sofa.
A small wooden toy car is caught right at the turn, mid-skid, pencil skid lines curling behind it.
The mood is quick, surprised turning.
shape-shifter:
A wooden arched bridge, a felt log lying flat and a tall wall of wooden blocks stand on the rug.
A felt badger stands in front of them, mid-step, deciding which to crawl under, jump over or run around.
The mood is quick thinking and play.
dance-recipe:
Three small felt cards lie in a row, stitched with a star, a low curve and a wiggly line.
Beside them a plush bear is caught in a wide star jump, matching the first card.
The mood is proud, careful remembering.
ghost-socks:
Three faint dotted sock outlines lie at odd distances along the rug, and the real socks are piled at one end.
A knitted frog is caught mid-jump, about to land right on the second ghost outline.
The mood is careful, confident leaping.
